# Rowan

> Rowan 0.23.4 is a vanilla Web Components design system: custom elements, Shadow DOM, and CSS tokens, with no framework runtime. The host owns data.

Documentation: https://2351labs.github.io/rowan/
Compact context: https://2351labs.github.io/rowan/llms.txt
Full context: https://2351labs.github.io/rowan/llms-full.txt
MCP server: `npx -y @rowan-ui/mcp` (`@rowan-ui/mcp@0.23.4`)

## Install

```bash
npm install @rowan-ui/core@0.23.4
```

`@rowan-ui/icons` is the optional icon set. `@rowan-ui/maplibre` is the optional MapLibre map.

```bash
npm install @rowan-ui/icons@0.23.4
npm install @rowan-ui/maplibre@0.23.4
```

The host keeps rows, locale, and routing. Components do not request them.

## Imports

Import `@rowan-ui/core/tokens` and a theme, then import each component from its package subpath. The subpath is the tag without the `rowan-` prefix: `<rowan-button>` is `@rowan-ui/core/button`, and that module registers the element. `import "@rowan-ui/core"` registers the full core catalog.

```js
import "@rowan-ui/core/tokens";
import "@rowan-ui/core/tokens/light";
import "@rowan-ui/core/button";

document.documentElement.dataset.theme = "light";
```

React wrappers are generated per component. `RowanButton` comes from `@rowan-ui/core/react/button` and maps `onRowanClick` to `rowan-click`. Vue, Angular, and Svelte use the custom element and the same subpath import.

Subpaths that differ from `@rowan-ui/core/<slug>`:

- `rowan-icon` imports `@rowan-ui/icons/element`. Each glyph is its own module. `import "@rowan-ui/icons/elements/<name>"` registers `<rowan-icon>` and that name. `@rowan-ui/icons/element` registers the class only.
- `rowan-maplibre-map` imports `@rowan-ui/maplibre/map`. Install the `maplibre-gl` peer next to `@rowan-ui/maplibre`. The map registers from `@rowan-ui/maplibre/map`.

## Theming

Rowan themes are CSS custom properties on `:root` or a `[data-theme]` scope. Primitive tokens feed semantic tokens, and component hooks follow the semantic layer. There is no JavaScript theme provider.

```js
import "@rowan-ui/core/tokens";
import "@rowan-ui/core/tokens/light";
import "@rowan-ui/core/tokens/dark";

document.documentElement.dataset.theme = "dark";
```

- Import the base tokens and one shipped theme, then set data-theme on the scope that should change.
- Product themes override semantic tokens (--rowan-color-bg, --rowan-color-fg, --rowan-color-accent, and the rest of that layer).
- Shipped theme files re-declare component aliases so a nested [data-theme] scope resolves those aliases again.
- CSS remains the runtime source of truth. @rowan-ui/core/tokens.json is a DTCG handoff for design tools.

### Shipped themes

- `light`: import `@rowan-ui/core/tokens/light` and set `data-theme="light"`.
- `dark`: import `@rowan-ui/core/tokens/dark` and set `data-theme="dark"`.
- `lagoon`: import `@rowan-ui/core/tokens/lagoon` and set `data-theme="lagoon"`.
- `ember`: import `@rowan-ui/core/tokens/ember` and set `data-theme="ember"`.
- `slate`: import `@rowan-ui/core/tokens/slate` and set `data-theme="slate"`.
- `midnight`: import `@rowan-ui/core/tokens/midnight` and set `data-theme="midnight"`.

### Semantic tokens

- `--rowan-color-accent`: `var(--rowan-color-forest-700)`
- `--rowan-color-accent-contrast`: `var(--rowan-color-bg)`
- `--rowan-color-bg`: `var(--rowan-color-sand-50)`
- `--rowan-color-border`: `#d8dcd5`
- `--rowan-color-danger`: `var(--rowan-color-danger-600)`
- `--rowan-color-fg`: `var(--rowan-color-ink-900)`
- `--rowan-color-muted`: `var(--rowan-color-ink-700)`
- `--rowan-color-success`: `#2f7a4d`
- `--rowan-color-surface`: `var(--rowan-color-bg)`
- `--rowan-color-warning`: `#9b7018`

Chart plots can opt into a separate palette: import `@rowan-ui/core/tokens/charts-vibrant` and set `data-rowan-charts="vibrant"`. Buttons and navigation stay on the Rowan theme. The palette applies only inside the region that sets the attribute.

Design-tool handoff: `@rowan-ui/core/tokens.json`.

## rowan-accordion

Expandable disclosure section.

- Package: `@rowan-ui/core@0.23.4`
- Import: `@rowan-ui/core/accordion`
- React: `RowanAccordion` from `@rowan-ui/core/react/accordion`
- Docs: https://2351labs.github.io/rowan/#accordion
- Module: `src/accordion/accordion.js`

### Attributes

| Name | Type | Default | Reflects | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| open | boolean | false | yes |  |
| summary | string | Details | yes |  |

### Properties

| Name | Type | Default | Reflects | Readonly | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| externalLabelText |  |  |  | yes | Text of any `<label for>` bound to the host. `label`/`for` cannot cross a shadow boundary. |
| open |  | false | yes |  |  |
| summary |  | Details | yes |  |  |

### Events

| Name | Detail | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| rowan-change |  | Fired when open state changes |

### Slots

| Name | Description |
| --- | --- |
| (default) | Body content |
| summary |  |

### CSS parts

| Name | Description |
| --- | --- |
| panel |  |
| trigger |  |

### CSS properties

None.

### Methods

None.

### Examples

### HTML

```html
<!doctype html>
<html lang="en">
  <head>
    <meta charset="utf-8" />
    <title>Accordion</title>
    <script type="module">
      import "@rowan-ui/core/tokens";
      import "@rowan-ui/core/tokens/light";
      import "@rowan-ui/core/accordion";
    </script>
  </head>
  <body>
    <rowan-accordion open>
  <span slot="summary">October release</span>
  <p>Keyboard focus, contrast, and table editing shipped this month.</p>
</rowan-accordion>

<rowan-accordion summary="Release notes">
  <p>Minor accessibility and performance updates.</p>
</rowan-accordion>
  </body>
</html>
```

### React

```tsx
import "@rowan-ui/core/tokens";
import "@rowan-ui/core/tokens/light";
import { RowanAccordion } from "@rowan-ui/core/react/accordion";

// RowanAccordion maps onRowanChange to the rowan-change event.
export function Example() {
  return (
    <RowanAccordion open>
      <span slot="summary">October release</span>
      <p>Keyboard focus, contrast, and table editing shipped this month.</p>
    </RowanAccordion>
    
    <RowanAccordion summary="Release notes">
      <p>Minor accessibility and performance updates.</p>
    </RowanAccordion>
  );
}
```

### Excerpt from documentation/component-examples.js

```html
<rowan-accordion open data-docs-demo-host>
        <span slot="summary">October release</span>
        <p>Keyboard focus, contrast, and table editing shipped this month.</p>
      </rowan-accordion>
      <rowan-accordion summary="Release notes">
        <p>Minor accessibility and performance updates.</p>
      </rowan-accordion>
```

### Excerpt from documentation/component-examples.js

```html
<rowan-accordion open>
  <span slot="summary">October release</span>
  <p>Keyboard focus, contrast, and table editing shipped this month.</p>
</rowan-accordion>

<rowan-accordion summary="Release notes">
  <p>Minor accessibility and performance updates.</p>
</rowan-accordion>
```


## rowan-alert

Status message surface with optional dismissal.

- Package: `@rowan-ui/core@0.23.4`
- Import: `@rowan-ui/core/alert`
- React: `RowanAlert` from `@rowan-ui/core/react/alert`
- Docs: https://2351labs.github.io/rowan/#alert

| tone | "info" \| "success" \| "warning" \| "danger" | info | yes |  |  |

```html
      import "@rowan-ui/core/tokens/light";
      import "@rowan-ui/core/alert";
```

```tsx
// RowanAlert maps onRowanDismiss to the rowan-dismiss event.
```

## rowan-app-layout

- Import: `@rowan-ui/core/app-layout`

### Attributes

| Name | Type | Default | Reflects | Description |

| navigation-label | string | Navigation | yes |  |
| navigation-open | boolean | false | yes |  |

### Properties

| Name | Type | Default | Reflects | Readonly | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| externalLabelText |  |  |  | yes | Text of any `<label for>` bound to the host. `label`/`for` cannot cross a shadow boundary. |
| messages | RowanAppLayoutMessages |  |  |  | Property-only built-in message overrides. |
| navigationLabel |  | Navigation | yes |  |  |
| navigationOpen |  | false | yes |  |  |

### Events

| Name | Detail | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| rowan-change |  | Fired when a user opens or closes compact navigation. |

### Slots

| Name | Description |
| --- | --- |

| header | Application header content. |
| navigation | Primary application navigation. |

### CSS parts

### Methods

### Examples

### HTML

```html
<!doctype html>
<html lang="en">
  <head>
    <meta charset="utf-8" />
    <title>App Layout</title>
    <script type="module">
      import "@rowan-ui/core/tokens";
      import "@rowan-ui/core/tokens/light";
      import "@rowan-ui/core/app-layout";
    </script>
  </head>
  <body>
    <rowan-app-layout>
  <div slot="header">Orders</div>
  <rowan-data-state state="ready">
    <rowan-table>
      <rowan-filter-builder slot="toolbar" appearance="toolbar"></rowan-filter-builder>
    </rowan-table>
    <p slot="empty">No matching rows.</p>
  </rowan-data-state>
</rowan-app-layout>
  </body>
</html>
```

### React

```tsx
import "@rowan-ui/core/tokens";
import "@rowan-ui/core/tokens/light";
import { RowanAppLayout } from "@rowan-ui/core/react/app-layout";

// RowanAppLayout maps onRowanChange to the rowan-change event.
export function Example() {
  return (
    <RowanAppLayout>
      <div slot="header">Orders</div>
      <rowan-data-state state="ready">
        <rowan-table>
          <rowan-filter-builder slot="toolbar" appearance="toolbar"></rowan-filter-builder>
        </rowan-table>
        <p slot="empty">No matching rows.</p>
      </rowan-data-state>
    </RowanAppLayout>
  );
}
```

### Excerpt from documentation/app.js (APP_LAYOUT_SNIPPET)

```html
<rowan-app-layout id="project-shell">
  <header slot="header">Northstar</header>
  <rowan-side-nav slot="navigation" label="Project navigation" value="overview">
    <rowan-side-nav-item value="overview" href="/overview">Overview</rowan-side-nav-item>
    <rowan-side-nav-item value="members" href="/members">Members</rowan-side-nav-item>
  </rowan-side-nav>
  <main>Project overview</main>
</rowan-app-layout>

<script type="module">
  import "@rowan-ui/core/app-layout";
  import "@rowan-ui/core/side-nav";

  const shell = document.querySelector("#project-shell");
  shell.addEventListener("rowan-change", (event) => {
    console.log(event.detail.navigationOpen);
  });
</script>
```


## rowan-area-chart

Filled multi-series area chart. Same data contract as the line chart. Null values break both the line and the fill.

- Package: `@rowan-ui/core@0.23.4`
- Import: `@rowan-ui/core/area-chart`
- React: `RowanAreaChart` from `@rowan-ui/core/react/area-chart`
- Docs: https://2351labs.github.io/rowan/#area-chart
- Module: `src/area-chart/area-chart.js`

### Attributes

| Name | Type | Default | Reflects | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| brush | boolean | false | yes | Drag, or Shift+Arrow, to select an x range. Escape clears it. |
| description | string |  | yes |  |
| hidden-series | string |  | yes | Space-separated series or slice ids hidden from the plot. |
| interactive | boolean | false | yes |  |
| label | string |  | yes |  |
| large-series | number |  |  | Downsample drawn marks above this count. The data table keeps every row. |
| locale | string |  | yes |  |
| no-motion | boolean | false | yes | Disables chart motion, including under prefers-reduced-motion. |
| sync-group | string |  |  | Share the axis pointer with charts that use the same group name. |
| zoom | boolean | false | yes | Opt-in plot zoom and pan. |

### Properties

| Name | Type | Default | Reflects | Readonly | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| config | RowanTrendChartConfig |  |  |  | Replaces the complete chart configuration. |
| description |  |  | yes |  |  |
| externalLabelText |  |  |  | yes | Text of any `<label for>` bound to the host. `label`/`for` cannot cross a shadow boundary. |
| hiddenSeries | string[] |  | yes |  | Ids hidden from the plot. The data table still lists them. |
| interactive |  | false | yes |  |  |
| label |  |  | yes |  |  |
| labels | string[] |  |  | yes | Point labels shared across series. Arrays are property-only. |
| locale |  |  | yes |  |  |
| messages | RowanAreaChartMessages |  |  |  | Property-only built-in message overrides. |
| noMotion |  |  | yes |  |  |
| referenceLines | RowanChartReferenceLine[] |  |  |  | Horizontal overlays. Arrays are property-only. |
| series | Array<RowanTrendChartSeries> |  |  |  | Chart series. Arrays are property-only. |
| tooltipFormatter | ((context: { text: string, event: Event, host: HTMLElement }) => string) \| null |  |  |  | Custom tooltip text. Property-only. |
| valueFormatter | RowanTrendChartValueFormatter \| null |  |  |  | Formats chart and table values. Its context includes tick for compact axis labels. Functions are property-only. |

### Events

| Name | Detail | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| rowan-brush | startIndex, endIndex, startLabel, endLabel, or cleared. | Selected range. Detail: startIndex, endIndex, startLabel, endLabel, or cleared. |
| rowan-point-activate |  | Fired when a user activates an interactive data point. |
| rowan-point-click | series, index, datum, value. | Cancelable. Detail: series, index, datum, value. |
| rowan-selection-change |  | Cancelable. Follows rowan-point-click when that event is not canceled. |
| rowan-series-toggle | seriesId, hiddenSeries. | Cancelable. Legend visibility toggle. Detail: seriesId, hiddenSeries. |
| rowan-sync | group, index, label. | Shared hover. Detail: group, index, label. |
| rowan-zoom | x, y, width, height. | Fired when the zoom window changes. Detail: x, y, width, height. |

### Slots

| Name | Description |
| --- | --- |
| description | Replaces the description attribute. |
| label | Replaces the label attribute. |
| tooltip | Custom tooltip content, used when tooltipFormatter is unset. |

### CSS parts

| Name | Description |
| --- | --- |
| area |  |
| chart |  |
| control |  |
| description |  |
| detail |  |
| hover |  |
| label |  |
| legend |  |
| legend-item |  |
| legend-swatch |  |
| line |  |
| plot |  |
| point |  |
| reference-line |  |
| summary |  |
| table |  |

### CSS properties

| Name | Description |
| --- | --- |
| --rowan-area-chart-bg |  |

### Methods

None.

### Examples

### HTML

```html
<!doctype html>
<html lang="en">
  <head>
    <meta charset="utf-8" />
    <title>Area Chart</title>
    <script type="module">
      import "@rowan-ui/core/tokens";
      import "@rowan-ui/core/tokens/light";
      import "@rowan-ui/core/area-chart";
    </script>
  </head>
  <body>
    <rowan-area-chart label="Area Chart"></rowan-area-chart>
  </body>
</html>
```

### React

```tsx

import "@rowan-ui/core/tokens/light";
import { RowanAreaChart } from "@rowan-ui/core/react/area-chart";

// RowanAreaChart maps onRowanBrush to the rowan-brush event.

  return (
    <RowanAreaChart label="Area Chart" />
  );
}
```

## rowan-bar-chart

Frozen small categorical bar chart. Native SVG, no animation.

- Package: `@rowan-ui/core@0.23.4`
- Import: `@rowan-ui/core/bar-chart`
- React: `RowanBarChart` from `@rowan-ui/core/react/bar-chart`

- Module: `src/bar-chart/bar-chart.js`

### Attributes

| Name | Type | Default | Reflects | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| brush | boolean | false | yes | Drag, or Shift+Arrow, to select an x range. Escape clears it. |
| description | string |  | yes |  |
| hidden-series | string |  | yes | Space-separated series or slice ids hidden from the plot. |
| interactive | boolean | false | yes |  |
| label | string |  | yes |  |
| large-series | number |  |  | Downsample drawn marks above this count. The data table keeps every row. |
| locale | string |  | yes |  |
| no-motion | boolean | false | yes | Disables chart motion, including under prefers-reduced-motion. |
| orientation | "vertical"\|"horizontal" | vertical | yes | Category axis. Default `vertical`. |
| sync-group | string |  |  | Share the axis pointer with charts that use the same group name. |
| zoom | boolean | false | yes | Opt-in plot zoom and pan. |

### Properties

| description |  |  | yes |  |  |

| hiddenSeries | string[] |  | yes |  | Ids hidden from the plot. The data table still lists them. |
| interactive |  | false | yes |  |  |
| label |  |  | yes |  |  |
| labels | string[] |  |  | yes | Category labels. Arrays are property-only. |
| locale |  |  | yes |  |  |
| messages | RowanBarChartMessages |  |  |  | Property-only built-in message overrides. |

| orientation | "vertical" \| "horizontal" | vertical | yes |  |  |
| series | Array<RowanChartSeries> |  |  |  | Chart series. Arrays are property-only. |
| tooltipFormatter | ((context: { text: string, event: Event, host: HTMLElement }) => string) \| null |  |  |  | Custom tooltip text. Property-only. |
| valueFormatter | RowanChartValueFormatter \| null |  |  |  | Formats chart and table values. Functions are property-only. |

### Events

| rowan-brush | startIndex, endIndex, startLabel, endLabel, or cleared. | Selected range. Detail: startIndex, endIndex, startLabel, endLabel, or cleared. |
| rowan-point-activate |  | Fired when a user activates an interactive bar. |
| rowan-point-click | series, index, datum, value. | Cancelable. Detail: series, index, datum, value. |
| rowan-selection-change |  | Cancelable. Follows rowan-point-click when that event is not canceled. |

| rowan-zoom | x, y, width, height. | Fired when the zoom window changes. Detail: x, y, width, height. |

## rowan-box-plot-chart

Box plot. Per-category `{ min, q1, median, q3, max, outliers? }`. The host does not compute quartiles. Null in the five-number summary is no-data. Own series model — not categorical `series.values`.

- Package: `@rowan-ui/core@0.23.4`
- Import: `@rowan-ui/core/box-plot-chart`
- React: `RowanBoxPlotChart` from `@rowan-ui/core/react/box-plot-chart`
- Docs: https://2351labs.github.io/rowan/#box-plot-chart
- Module: `src/box-plot-chart/box-plot-chart.js`

### Attributes

| Name | Type | Default | Reflects | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| brush | boolean | false | yes | Drag, or Shift+Arrow, to select an x range. Escape clears it. |
| description | string |  | yes |  |
| hidden-series | string |  | yes | Space-separated series or slice ids hidden from the plot. |
| interactive | boolean | false | yes |  |
| label | string |  | yes |  |
| large-series | number |  |  | Downsample drawn marks above this count. The data table keeps every row. |
| locale | string |  | yes |  |
| no-motion | boolean | false | yes | Disables chart motion, including under prefers-reduced-motion. |
| sync-group | string |  |  | Share the axis pointer with charts that use the same group name. |
| zoom | boolean | false | yes | Opt-in plot zoom and pan. |

### Properties

| Name | Type | Default | Reflects | Readonly | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| config | RowanBoxPlotChartConfig |  |  |  | Replaces the complete chart configuration. |
| description |  |  | yes |  |  |
| externalLabelText |  |  |  | yes | Text of any `<label for>` bound to the host. `label`/`for` cannot cross a shadow boundary. |
| hiddenSeries | string[] |  | yes |  | Ids hidden from the plot. The data table still lists them. |
| interactive |  | false | yes |  |  |
| label |  |  | yes |  |  |
| labels | string[] |  |  | yes | Category labels. Arrays are property-only. |
| locale |  |  | yes |  |  |
| messages | RowanBoxPlotChartMessages |  |  |  | Property-only built-in message overrides. |
| noMotion |  |  | yes |  |  |
| series | Array<object> |  |  |  | Series of `{ id, label, color?, values: [{ min, q1, median, q3, max, outliers? }] }`. Arrays are property-only. |
| tooltipFormatter | ((context: { text: string, event: Event, host: HTMLElement }) => string) \| null |  |  |  | Custom tooltip text. Property-only. |
| valueFormatter | RowanBoxPlotChartValueFormatter \| null |  |  |  | Formats table and hover values. Functions are property-only. |

### Events

| Name | Detail | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| rowan-brush | startIndex, endIndex, startLabel, endLabel, or cleared. | Selected range. Detail: startIndex, endIndex, startLabel, endLabel, or cleared. |
| rowan-point-activate |  | Fired when a user activates an interactive box. Detail includes min, q1, median, q3, and max. |
| rowan-point-click | series, index, datum, value. | Cancelable. Detail: series, index, datum, value. |
| rowan-selection-change |  | Cancelable. Follows rowan-point-click when that event is not canceled. |
| rowan-series-toggle | seriesId, hiddenSeries. | Cancelable. Legend visibility toggle. Detail: seriesId, hiddenSeries. |
| rowan-sync | group, index, label. | Shared hover. Detail: group, index, label. |
| rowan-zoom | x, y, width, height. | Fired when the zoom window changes. Detail: x, y, width, height. |

### Slots

| Name | Description |
| --- | --- |
| description |  |
| label |  |
| tooltip | Custom tooltip content, used when tooltipFormatter is unset. |

### CSS parts

| --- | --- |

| median |  |
| outlier |  |
| plot |  |
| table |  |
| whisker |  |

## rowan-bulk-actions-bar

Contextual bulk actions for selected rows in a Rowan data table.

- Package: `@rowan-ui/core@0.23.4`

### Events

| Name | Description |
| --- | --- |

### Examples

### HTML

```html
<!doctype html>
<html lang="en">
  <head>
    <meta charset="utf-8" />
    <title>Bulk Actions Bar</title>
    <script type="module">
      import "@rowan-ui/core/tokens";
      import "@rowan-ui/core/tokens/light";
      import "@rowan-ui/core/bulk-actions-bar";
    </script>
  </head>
  <body>
    <rowan-table id="members-table">
  <rowan-bulk-actions-bar id="member-actions" slot="toolbar"></rowan-bulk-actions-bar>
</rowan-table>

<script type="module">
  const actions = document.querySelector("#member-actions");
  actions.actions = [
    { id: "archive", label: "Archive", variant: "secondary" },
    { id: "remove", label: "Remove", variant: "danger" },
  ];

  actions.addEventListener("rowan-bulk-action", (event) => {
    console.log(event.detail.action, event.detail.selectedRows);
  });
</script>
  </body>
</html>
```

### React

```tsx
import "@rowan-ui/core/tokens";
import "@rowan-ui/core/tokens/light";
import { RowanBulkActionsBar } from "@rowan-ui/core/react/bulk-actions-bar";

// RowanBulkActionsBar maps onRowanBulkAction to the rowan-bulk-action event.
export function Example() {
  return (
    <rowan-table id="members-table">
      <RowanBulkActionsBar id="member-actions" slot="toolbar" />
    </rowan-table>
    
    <script type="module">
      const actions = document.querySelector("#member-actions");
      actions.actions = [
        { id: "archive", label: "Archive", variant: "secondary" },
        { id: "remove", label: "Remove", variant: "danger" },
      ];
    
      actions.addEventListener("rowan-bulk-action", (event) => {
        console.log(event.detail.action, event.detail.selectedRows);
      });
    </script>
  );
}
```

### Excerpt from documentation/app.js (BULK_ACTIONS_BAR_SNIPPET)


## rowan-bullet-chart

Compact qualitative comparison after Stephen Few's bullet graph spec.

- Package: `@rowan-ui/core@0.23.4`
- Import: `@rowan-ui/core/bullet-chart`
- React: `RowanBulletChart` from `@rowan-ui/core/react/bullet-chart`
- Docs: https://2351labs.github.io/rowan/#bullet-chart
- Module: `src/bullet-chart/bullet-chart.js`

### Attributes

| Name | Type | Default | Reflects | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| encoding | "ink"\|"accent"\|"status"\|"tone" | ink | yes | Range fill. `ink` grayscale (default). `accent` one theme hue. `status` poor→good mix. `tone` per-range hues. |
| hidden-series | string |  | yes | Space-separated series or slice ids hidden from the plot. |
| intent | "higher"\|"lower" |  | yes | Dark bands encode poor performance. |
| label | string |  | yes |  |
| locale | string |  | yes |  |
| no-motion | boolean | false | yes | Disables chart motion, including under prefers-reduced-motion. |
| scale | boolean | false | yes | Show quantitative ticks. Default true. |

### Properties

| Name | Type | Default | Reflects | Readonly | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| encoding | "ink" \| "accent" \| "status" \| "tone" | ink | yes |  |  |
| externalLabelText |  |  |  | yes | Text of any `<label for>` bound to the host. `label`/`for` cannot cross a shadow boundary. |
| hiddenSeries | string[] |  | yes |  | `actual` hides the bar, `target` hides the target, and a range tone (`danger`, `warning`, `success`, `info`, `neutral`) hides that band. The data table still lists them. |
| intent | "higher" \| "lower" |  | yes |  |  |
| label |  |  | yes |  |  |
| locale |  |  | yes |  |  |
| messages | RowanBulletChartMessages |  |  |  | Property-only built-in message overrides. |
| noMotion |  |  | yes |  |  |
| ranges | RowanBulletChartRange[] |  |  |  |  |
| scale |  |  | yes |  |  |
| target | number \| null |  |  |  |  |
| tooltipFormatter | ((context: { text: string, event: Event, host: HTMLElement }) => string) \| null |  |  |  | Custom tooltip text. Property-only. |
| value | number \| null |  |  |  |  |

### Events

| Name | Detail | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| rowan-point-activate | index, label, value. | Keyboard activation. Detail: index, label, value. |
| rowan-point-click | series, index, datum, value. | Cancelable. Detail: series, index, datum, value. |
| rowan-selection-change |  | Cancelable. Follows rowan-point-click when that event is not canceled. |
| rowan-series-toggle | seriesId, hiddenSeries. | Cancelable. Legend visibility toggle. Detail: seriesId, hiddenSeries. |

### Slots

| Name | Description |
| --- | --- |
| tooltip | Custom tooltip content, used when tooltipFormatter is unset. |

### CSS parts

| Name | Description |
| --- | --- |
| actual |  |
| chart |  |
| hover |  |
| plot |  |
| range |  |
| table |  |
| target |  |
| tick |  |

### CSS properties

None.

### Methods

None.

### Examples

### HTML

```html
<!doctype html>
<html lang="en">
  <head>
    <meta charset="utf-8" />
    <title>Bullet Chart</title>
    <script type="module">
      import "@rowan-ui/core/tokens";
      import "@rowan-ui/core/tokens/light";
      import "@rowan-ui/core/bullet-chart";
    </script>
  </head>
  <body>
    <rowan-kpi-card label="Fill rate" tone="success" delta-label="vs target">
  <rowan-bullet-chart slot="chart" label="Fill rate versus target"></rowan-bullet-chart>
</rowan-kpi-card>

<script type="module">
  import "@rowan-ui/core/kpi-card";
  import "@rowan-ui/core/bullet-chart";

  const card = document.querySelector("rowan-kpi-card");
  const chart = document.querySelector("rowan-bullet-chart");
  card.value = 82;
  card.delta = -8;
  chart.value = 82;
  chart.target = 90;
  chart.ranges = [
    { from: 0, to: 60, label: "Poor", tone: "danger" },
    { from: 60, to: 80, label: "Fair", tone: "warning" },
    { from: 80, to: 100, label: "Good", tone: "success" },
  ];
</script>
  </body>
</html>
```

### React

```tsx
import "@rowan-ui/core/tokens";
import "@rowan-ui/core/tokens/light";
import { RowanBulletChart } from "@rowan-ui/core/react/bullet-chart";

// RowanBulletChart maps onRowanPointActivate to the rowan-point-activate event.
export function Example() {
  return (
    <rowan-kpi-card label="Fill rate" tone="success" delta-label="vs target">
      <RowanBulletChart slot="chart" label="Fill rate versus target" />
    </rowan-kpi-card>
    
    <script type="module">
      import "@rowan-ui/core/kpi-card";
      import "@rowan-ui/core/bullet-chart";
    
      const card = document.querySelector("rowan-kpi-card");
      const chart = document.querySelector("rowan-bullet-chart");
      card.value = 82;
      card.delta = -8;
      chart.value = 82;
      chart.target = 90;
      chart.ranges = [
        { from: 0, to: 60, label: "Poor", tone: "danger" },
        { from: 60, to: 80, label: "Fair", tone: "warning" },
        { from: 80, to: 100, label: "Good", tone: "success" },
      ];
    </script>
  );
}
```

## rowan-carousel

Controlled sequence of slotted content panels.

- Package: `@rowan-ui/core@0.23.4`
- Import: `@rowan-ui/core/carousel`
- React: `RowanCarousel` from `@rowan-ui/core/react/carousel`
- Docs: https://2351labs.github.io/rowan/#carousel
- Module: `src/carousel/carousel.js`

### Attributes

| Name | Type | Default | Reflects | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| active-index | number | 0 | yes |  |
| label | string | Carousel | yes |  |

### Properties

| Name | Type | Default | Reflects | Readonly | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| activeIndex |  | 0 | yes |  |  |
| externalLabelText |  |  |  | yes | Text of any `<label for>` bound to the host. `label`/`for` cannot cross a shadow boundary. |
| label |  | Carousel | yes |  |  |
| messages | RowanCarouselMessages |  |  |  | Property-only built-in message overrides. |

### Events

| Name | Detail | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| rowan-change |  | Fired when a user changes the active panel |

### Slots

| Name | Description |
| --- | --- |
| (default) | Carousel panels |

### CSS parts

| Name | Description |
| --- | --- |
| carousel |  |
| controls |  |
| next-button |  |
| previous-button |  |
| status |  |
| viewport |  |

### CSS properties

| Name | Description |
| --- | --- |
| --rowan-carousel-border |  |
| --rowan-carousel-control-bg |  |
| --rowan-carousel-control-fg |  |
| --rowan-carousel-focus-ring |  |

### Methods

| Name | Description |
| --- | --- |
| goTo(index) | Activates a panel without emitting `rowan-change`. |
| next() |  |
| previous() |  |

### Examples

### HTML

```html
<!doctype html>
<html lang="en">
  <head>
    <meta charset="utf-8" />
    <title>Carousel</title>
    <script type="module">
      import "@rowan-ui/core/tokens";
      import "@rowan-ui/core/tokens/light";
      import "@rowan-ui/core/carousel";
    </script>
  </head>
  <body>
    <rowan-carousel id="release-carousel" label="Release highlights" active-index="1">
  <article>
    <h3>Release readiness</h3>
    <p>Rollback coverage is in place for the deployment window.</p>
  </article>
  <article>
    <h3>Service coverage</h3>
    <p>Confirm the weekend handoff before the window opens.</p>
  </article>
  <article>
    <h3>Customer communication</h3>
    <p>The customer notice is scheduled with the impact summary.</p>
  </article>
</rowan-carousel>

<script type="module">
  import "@rowan-ui/core/carousel";

  const carousel = document.querySelector("#release-carousel");
  carousel.addEventListener("rowan-change", (event) => {
    console.log(event.detail.activeIndex);
  });
</script>
  </body>
</html>
```

### React

```tsx
import "@rowan-ui/core/tokens";
import "@rowan-ui/core/tokens/light";
import { RowanCarousel } from "@rowan-ui/core/react/carousel";

// RowanCarousel maps onRowanChange to the rowan-change event.
export function Example() {
  return (
    <RowanCarousel id="release-carousel" label="Release highlights" active-index="1">
      <article>
        <h3>Release readiness</h3>
        <p>Rollback coverage is in place for the deployment window.</p>
      </article>
      <article>
        <h3>Service coverage</h3>
        <p>Confirm the weekend handoff before the window opens.</p>
      </article>
      <article>
        <h3>Customer communication</h3>
        <p>The customer notice is scheduled with the impact summary.</p>
      </article>
    </RowanCarousel>
    
    <script type="module">
      import "@rowan-ui/core/carousel";
    
      const carousel = document.querySelector("#release-carousel");
      carousel.addEventListener("rowan-change", (event) => {
        console.log(event.detail.activeIndex);
      });
    </script>
  );
}
```

### Excerpt from documentation/app.js (CAROUSEL_SNIPPET)


## rowan-color-picker

Accessible semantic color selection with approved swatches and alpha-enabled custom entry.

- Package: `@rowan-ui/core@0.23.4`
- Import: `@rowan-ui/core/color-picker`
- React: `RowanColorPicker` from `@rowan-ui/core/react/color-picker`

- Module: `src/color-picker/color-picker.js`

### Attributes

| Name | Type | Default | Reflects | Description |

| description | string |  | yes |  |
| disabled | boolean | false | yes |  |
| invalid | boolean | false | yes |  |
| label | string |  | yes |  |

| required | boolean | false | yes |  |
| value | string |  | yes | A normalized #rrggbb or #rrggbbaa color. |

### Properties

| Name | Type | Default | Reflects | Readonly | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| description |  |  | yes |  |  |
| disabled |  | false | yes |  |  |
| externalLabelText |  |  |  | yes | Text of any `<label for>` bound to the host. `label`/`for` cannot cross a shadow boundary. |
| invalid |  | false | yes |  |  |
| label |  |  | yes |  |  |
| messages | RowanColorPickerMessages |  |  |  | Property-only built-in message overrides. |
| name |  |  | yes |  |  |
| palette | Array<string \| RowanColorPickerPaletteEntry> |  |  |  | Approved palette entries. Arrays are property-only. |
| required |  | false | yes |  |  |
| value |  |  | yes |  |  |

### Events

| Name | Detail | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |

| label |  |

### CSS properties

| Name | Description |

### Methods

### Examples

### HTML

```html
<!doctype html>
<html lang="en">
  <head>
    <meta charset="utf-8" />
    <title>Color Picker</title>
    <script type="module">
      import "@rowan-ui/core/tokens";
      import "@rowan-ui/core/tokens/light";
      import "@rowan-ui/core/color-picker";
    </script>
  </head>
  <body>
    <rowan-color-picker
  id="project-color"
  name="projectColor"
  label="Project color"
  value="#1d432f"
></rowan-color-picker>

<script type="module">
  import "@rowan-ui/core/color-picker";

  const picker = document.querySelector("#project-color");
  picker.palette = [
    { value: "#1d432f", label: "Forest" },
    { value: "#24543c", label: "Canopy" },
    { value: "#b4392d", label: "Signal" },
  ];

  picker.addEventListener("rowan-change", (event) => {
    console.log(event.detail.value);
  });
</script>
  </body>
</html>
```

### React

```tsx
import "@rowan-ui/core/tokens";
import "@rowan-ui/core/tokens/light";
import { RowanColorPicker } from "@rowan-ui/core/react/color-picker";

// RowanColorPicker maps onRowanChange to the rowan-change event.
export function Example() {
  return (
    <RowanColorPicker
      id="project-color"
      name="projectColor"
      label="Project color"
      value="#1d432f"
     />
    
    <script type="module">
      import "@rowan-ui/core/color-picker";
    
      const picker = document.querySelector("#project-color");
      picker.palette = [
        { value: "#1d432f", label: "Forest" },
        { value: "#24543c", label: "Canopy" },
        { value: "#b4392d", label: "Signal" },
      ];
    
      picker.addEventListener("rowan-change", (event) => {
        console.log(event.detail.value);
      });
    </script>
  );
}
```

## rowan-column-sparkline

Frozen compact one-series columns for KPI tiles. Not a density of `rowan-bar-chart`. Not a `variant` of `rowan-sparkline`.

- Package: `@rowan-ui/core@0.23.4`
- Import: `@rowan-ui/core/column-sparkline`
- React: `RowanColumnSparkline` from `@rowan-ui/core/react/column-sparkline`
- Docs: https://2351labs.github.io/rowan/#column-sparkline
- Module: `src/column-sparkline/column-sparkline.js`

### Attributes

| Name | Type | Default | Reflects | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| above-tone | "neutral"\|"info"\|"success"\|"warning"\|"danger" | neutral | yes | Fill above target. Used when `target` is set. |
| below-tone | "neutral"\|"info"\|"success"\|"warning"\|"danger" | success | yes | Fill at or below target. Used when `target` is set. |
| brush | boolean | false | yes | Drag, or Shift+Arrow, to select an x range. Escape clears it. |
| hidden-series | string |  | yes | Space-separated series or slice ids hidden from the plot. |
| label | string |  | yes |  |
| large-series | number |  |  | Downsample drawn marks above this count. The data table keeps every row. |
| locale | string |  | yes |  |
| no-motion | boolean | false | yes | Disables chart motion, including under prefers-reduced-motion. |
| sync-group | string |  |  | Share the axis pointer with charts that use the same group name. |
| tone | "neutral"\|"info"\|"success"\|"warning"\|"danger" | neutral | yes |  |

### Properties

| Name | Type | Default | Reflects | Readonly | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| aboveTone | "neutral" \| "info" \| "success" \| "warning" \| "danger" | neutral | yes |  |  |
| belowTone | "neutral" \| "info" \| "success" \| "warning" \| "danger" | success | yes |  |  |
| externalLabelText |  |  |  | yes | Text of any `<label for>` bound to the host. `label`/`for` cannot cross a shadow boundary. |
| hiddenSeries | string[] |  | yes |  | `series` hides the columns. `target` hides the target. The data table still lists them. |
| label |  |  | yes |  |  |
| labels | string[] |  |  | yes | Optional point labels for the accessible table. Arrays are property-only. |
| locale |  |  | yes |  |  |
| messages | RowanColumnSparklineMessages |  |  |  | Property-only built-in message overrides. |
| noMotion |  |  | yes |  |  |
| target | number \| null |  |  |  | Target value. Property-only. Null hides the split and the dashed line. |
| tone | "neutral" \| "info" \| "success" \| "warning" \| "danger" | neutral | yes |  |  |
| tooltipFormatter | ((context: { text: string, event: Event, host: HTMLElement }) => string) \| null |  |  |  | Custom tooltip text. Property-only. |
| values | Array<number \| null> |  |  |  | One series. Arrays are property-only. Null is a gap. |

### Events

| Name | Detail | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| rowan-brush | startIndex, endIndex, startLabel, endLabel, or cleared. | Selected range. Detail: startIndex, endIndex, startLabel, endLabel, or cleared. |
| rowan-point-click | series, index, datum, value. | Cancelable. Detail: series, index, datum, value. |
| rowan-selection-change |  | Cancelable. Follows rowan-point-click when that event is not canceled. |
| rowan-series-toggle | seriesId, hiddenSeries. | Cancelable. Legend visibility toggle. Detail: seriesId, hiddenSeries. |
| rowan-sync | group, index, label. | Shared hover. Detail: group, index, label. |

### Slots

| Name | Description |
| --- | --- |
| tooltip | Custom tooltip content, used when tooltipFormatter is unset. |

### CSS parts

| Name | Description |
| --- | --- |
| chart |  |
| column |  |
| hover |  |
| plot |  |
| table |  |
| target |  |

### CSS properties

| Name | Description |
| --- | --- |
| --rowan-column-sparkline-danger |  |
| --rowan-column-sparkline-fill |  |
| --rowan-column-sparkline-height |  |
| --rowan-column-sparkline-info |  |
| --rowan-column-sparkline-success |  |
| --rowan-column-sparkline-target |  |
| --rowan-column-sparkline-target-width |  |
| --rowan-column-sparkline-warning |  |

### Methods

None.

### Examples

### HTML

```html
<!doctype html>
<html lang="en">
  <head>
    <meta charset="utf-8" />
    <title>Column Sparkline</title>
    <script type="module">
      import "@rowan-ui/core/tokens";
      import "@rowan-ui/core/tokens/light";
      import "@rowan-ui/core/column-sparkline";
    </script>
  </head>
  <body>
    <rowan-kpi-card label="Open incidents" tone="warning" delta-label="vs last week">
  <rowan-column-sparkline slot="chart" label="Open incidents this week"></rowan-column-sparkline>
</rowan-kpi-card>

<script type="module">
  import "@rowan-ui/core/kpi-card";
  import "@rowan-ui/core/column-sparkline";

  const card = document.querySelector("rowan-kpi-card");
  const chart = document.querySelector("rowan-column-sparkline");
  card.value = 11;
  card.delta = -7;
  chart.values = [18, 24, 12, 15, 9, 11];
</script>
  </body>
</html>
```

```tsx
// RowanColumnSparkline maps onRowanBrush to the rowan-brush event.

      const chart = document.querySelector("rowan-column-sparkline");

      card.delta = -7;
      chart.values = [18, 24, 12, 15, 9, 11];
    </script>
  );
}
```

## rowan-combo-chart

Categorical combo: bars, lines, and areas on a shared category axis. Optional `axis: "secondary"` for a second value scale (Pareto cumulative %). Bar, area, and trend charts stay separate hosts.

- Package: `@rowan-ui/core@0.23.4`
- Import: `@rowan-ui/core/combo-chart`
- React: `RowanComboChart` from `@rowan-ui/core/react/combo-chart`
- Docs: https://2351labs.github.io/rowan/#combo-chart
- Module: `src/combo-chart/combo-chart.js`

### Attributes

| Name | Type | Default | Reflects | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| brush | boolean | false | yes | Drag, or Shift+Arrow, to select an x range. Escape clears it. |
| description | string |  | yes |  |
| hidden-series | string |  | yes | Space-separated series or slice ids hidden from the plot. |
| interactive | boolean | false | yes |  |
| label | string |  | yes |  |
| large-series | number |  |  | Downsample drawn marks above this count. The data table keeps every row. |
| locale | string |  | yes |  |
| no-motion | boolean | false | yes | Disables chart motion, including under prefers-reduced-motion. |
| sync-group | string |  |  | Share the axis pointer with charts that use the same group name. |
| zoom | boolean | false | yes | Opt-in plot zoom and pan. |

### Properties

| Name | Type | Default | Reflects | Readonly | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| config | object |  |  |  | Replaces the complete chart configuration. |
| description |  |  | yes |  |  |
| externalLabelText |  |  |  | yes | Text of any `<label for>` bound to the host. `label`/`for` cannot cross a shadow boundary. |
| hiddenSeries | string[] |  | yes |  | Ids hidden from the plot. The data table still lists them. |
| interactive |  | false | yes |  |  |
| label |  |  | yes |  |  |
| labels | string[] |  |  | yes | Category labels. Arrays are property-only. |
| locale |  |  | yes |  |  |
| messages | RowanComboChartMessages |  |  |  | Property-only built-in message overrides. |
| noMotion |  |  | yes |  |  |
| referenceLines | RowanChartReferenceLine[] |  |  |  | Horizontal overlays. Optional axis primary\|secondary. Arrays are property-only. |
| series | Array<object> |  |  |  | Chart series with optional geometry (bar\|line\|area) and axis (primary\|secondary). Arrays are property-only. Invalid geometry falls back to bar. |
| tooltipFormatter | ((context: { text: string, event: Event, host: HTMLElement }) => string) \| null |  |  |  | Custom tooltip text. Property-only. |
| valueFormatter | RowanChartValueFormatter \| null |  |  |  | Formats chart and table values. Functions are property-only. |

### Events

| Name | Detail | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| rowan-brush | startIndex, endIndex, startLabel, endLabel, or cleared. | Selected range. Detail: startIndex, endIndex, startLabel, endLabel, or cleared. |
| rowan-point-activate |  | Fired when a user activates an interactive mark. |
| rowan-point-click | series, index, datum, value. | Cancelable. Detail: series, index, datum, value. |
| rowan-selection-change |  | Cancelable. Follows rowan-point-click when that event is not canceled. |
| rowan-series-toggle | seriesId, hiddenSeries. | Cancelable. Legend visibility toggle. Detail: seriesId, hiddenSeries. |
| rowan-sync | group, index, label. | Shared hover. Detail: group, index, label. |
| rowan-zoom | x, y, width, height. | Fired when the zoom window changes. Detail: x, y, width, height. |

### Slots

| Name | Description |
| --- | --- |
| description |  |
| label |  |
| tooltip | Custom tooltip content, used when tooltipFormatter is unset. |

### CSS parts

| Name | Description |
| --- | --- |
| area |  |
| bar |  |
| control |  |
| hover |  |
| line |  |
| plot |  |
| table |  |

| --- | --- |

## rowan-combobox

Filterable text entry with a listbox of suggestions. Focus stays in the input and the highlighted option is reported with `aria-activedescendant`, matching the APG combobox pattern.

- Package: `@rowan-ui/core@0.23.4`
- Import: `@rowan-ui/core/combobox`

| name | string |  | yes |  |
| open | boolean | false | yes |  |
| placeholder | string |  | yes |  |
| required | boolean | false | yes |  |
| value | string |  | yes |  |

### Properties

| Name | Type | Default | Reflects | Readonly | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| disabled |  | false | yes |  |  |
| externalLabelText |  |  |  | yes | Text of any `<label for>` bound to the host. `label`/`for` cannot cross a shadow boundary. |
| label |  |  | yes |  |  |
| locale |  |  | yes |  |  |
| messages | RowanComboboxMessages |  |  |  | Property-only built-in message overrides. |
| name |  |  | yes |  |  |
| open |  | false | yes |  |  |

```tsx
// RowanCombobox maps onRowanChange to the rowan-change event.

    <script type="module">
      const city = document.querySelector("#city");
```

## rowan-command-palette

Keyboard-first command surface for filtering and activating command items.

- Package: `@rowan-ui/core@0.23.4`
- Import: `@rowan-ui/core/command-palette`
- React: `RowanCommandPalette` from `@rowan-ui/core/react/command-palette`
- Docs: https://2351labs.github.io/rowan/#command-palette
- Module: `src/command-palette/command-palette.js`

### Attributes

| Name | Type | Default | Reflects | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| empty-label | string |  | yes |  |
| hotkey | string |  | yes |  |
| label | string |  | yes |  |
| locale | string |  | yes |  |
| open | boolean | false | yes |  |
| placeholder | string |  | yes |  |
| query | string |  | yes |  |

### Properties

| Name | Type | Default | Reflects | Readonly | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| emptyLabel |  |  | yes |  |  |
| externalLabelText |  |  |  | yes | Text of any `<label for>` bound to the host. `label`/`for` cannot cross a shadow boundary. |
| hotkey |  |  | yes |  |  |
| label |  |  | yes |  |  |
| locale |  |  | yes |  |  |
| messages | RowanCommandPaletteMessages |  |  |  | Property-only built-in message overrides. |
| open |  | false | yes |  |  |
| placeholder |  |  | yes |  |  |
| query |  |  | yes |  |  |

### Events

| Name | Detail | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| rowan-close |  | Fired when a user dismisses the palette |
| rowan-command |  | Fired when a user activates a command |

### Slots

| Name | Description |
| --- | --- |
| (default) | rowan-command-item nodes |
| empty |  |

### CSS parts

| Name | Description |
| --- | --- |
| close |  |
| empty |  |
| input |  |
| list |  |
| overlay |  |
| panel |  |

### CSS properties

| Name | Description |
| --- | --- |
| --rowan-command-palette-bg |  |
| --rowan-command-palette-width |  |

### Methods

| Name | Description |
| --- | --- |
| focusSearch() |  |
| hide() |  |
| show() |  |
| toggle() |  |

### Examples

### HTML

```html
<!doctype html>
<html lang="en">
  <head>
    <meta charset="utf-8" />
    <title>Command Palette</title>
    <script type="module">
      import "@rowan-ui/core/tokens";
      import "@rowan-ui/core/tokens/light";
      import "@rowan-ui/core/command-palette";
    </script>
  </head>
  <body>
    <rowan-button id="open-commands">Open commands</rowan-button>

<rowan-command-palette
  id="workspace-commands"
  label="Workspace commands"
  hotkey="mod+k"
>
  <rowan-command-item
    value="open-settings"
    label="Open settings"
    description="Update workspace preferences"
    keywords="workspace preferences account"
    shortcut="G S"
  ></rowan-command-item>
  <rowan-command-item
    value="invite-member"
    label="Invite member"
    keywords="team people invite"
    shortcut="I"
  ></rowan-command-item>
</rowan-command-palette>

<script type="module">
  import "@rowan-ui/core/button";
  import "@rowan-ui/core/command-palette";

  const trigger = document.querySelector("#open-commands");
  const palette = document.querySelector("#workspace-commands");

  trigger.addEventListener("rowan-click", () => palette.show());
  palette.addEventListener("rowan-command", (event) => {
    console.log(event.detail.value, event.detail.item);
  });
</script>
  </body>
</html>
```

### React

```tsx
import "@rowan-ui/core/tokens";
import "@rowan-ui/core/tokens/light";
import { RowanCommandPalette } from "@rowan-ui/core/react/command-palette";

// RowanCommandPalette maps onRowanClose to the rowan-close event.
export function Example() {
  return (
    <rowan-button id="open-commands">Open commands</rowan-button>
    
    <RowanCommandPalette
      id="workspace-commands"
      label="Workspace commands"
      hotkey="mod+k"
    >
      <rowan-command-item
        value="open-settings"
        label="Open settings"
        description="Update workspace preferences"
        keywords="workspace preferences account"
        shortcut="G S"
      ></rowan-command-item>
      <rowan-command-item
        value="invite-member"
        label="Invite member"
        keywords="team people invite"
        shortcut="I"
      ></rowan-command-item>
    </RowanCommandPalette>
    
    <script type="module">
      import "@rowan-ui/core/button";
      import "@rowan-ui/core/command-palette";
    
      const trigger = document.querySelector("#open-commands");
      const palette = document.querySelector("#workspace-commands");
    
      trigger.addEventListener("rowan-click", () => palette.show());
      palette.addEventListener("rowan-command", (event) => {
        console.log(event.detail.value, event.detail.item);
      });
    </script>
  );
}
```

| messages | RowanConfirmDialogMessages |  |  |  | Property-only built-in message overrides. |
| open |  | false | yes |  |  |

### Events

| Name | Detail | Description |

| rowan-close |  | Fired when the user passively dismisses the dialog |
| rowan-confirm |  | Fired when the user confirms the action |

```html
      import "@rowan-ui/core/confirm-dialog";

  });

  </body>
```

## rowan-context-menu

Contextual action menu bound to an element by property or identifier.

- Package: `@rowan-ui/core@0.23.4`
- Import: `@rowan-ui/core/context-menu`
- React: `RowanContextMenu` from `@rowan-ui/core/react/context-menu`
- Docs: https://2351labs.github.io/rowan/#context-menu
- Module: `src/context-menu/context-menu.js`

### Attributes

| Name | Type | Default | Reflects | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| for | string |  |  |  |
| label | string |  | yes |  |
| open | boolean | false | yes |  |

### Properties

| Name | Type | Default | Reflects | Readonly | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| externalLabelText |  |  |  | yes | Text of any `<label for>` bound to the host. `label`/`for` cannot cross a shadow boundary. |
| forTarget |  |  |  |  |  |
| label |  |  | yes |  |  |
| messages | RowanContextMenuMessages |  |  |  | Property-only built-in message overrides. |
| open |  | false | yes |  |  |
| target | HTMLElement \| null |  |  |  |  |

### Events

| Name | Detail | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| rowan-change |  | Fired when the user selects a contextual action |
| rowan-close |  | Fired when the user dismisses the menu |

### Slots

| Name | Description |
| --- | --- |
| (default) | rowan-menu-item actions |

### CSS parts

| Name | Description |
| --- | --- |
| backdrop |  |
| menu |  |
| overlay |  |
| panel |  |

### CSS properties

| Name | Description |
| --- | --- |
| --rowan-context-menu-offset |  |
| --rowan-context-menu-z-index |  |

### Methods

| Name | Description |
| --- | --- |
| hide() |  |
| refresh() |  |
| showAt(x, y) |  |

### Examples

### HTML

```html
<!doctype html>
<html lang="en">
  <head>
    <meta charset="utf-8" />
    <title>Context Menu</title>
    <script type="module">
      import "@rowan-ui/core/tokens";
      import "@rowan-ui/core/tokens/light";
      import "@rowan-ui/core/context-menu";
    </script>
  </head>
  <body>
    <button id="project-target" type="button">Trail map</button>

<rowan-context-menu for="project-target" label="Project actions">
  <rowan-menu-item value="rename">Rename</rowan-menu-item>
  <rowan-menu-item value="archive">Archive</rowan-menu-item>
</rowan-context-menu>

<script type="module">
  import "@rowan-ui/core/context-menu";
  import "@rowan-ui/core/menu-item";

  const menu = document.querySelector("rowan-context-menu");
  menu.addEventListener("rowan-change", (event) => {
    console.log(event.detail.value);
  });
</script>
  </body>
</html>
```

### React

```tsx
import "@rowan-ui/core/tokens";
import "@rowan-ui/core/tokens/light";
import { RowanContextMenu } from "@rowan-ui/core/react/context-menu";

// RowanContextMenu maps onRowanChange to the rowan-change event.
export function Example() {
  return (
    <button id="project-target" type="button">Trail map</button>
    
    <RowanContextMenu for="project-target" label="Project actions">
      <rowan-menu-item value="rename">Rename</rowan-menu-item>
      <rowan-menu-item value="archive">Archive</rowan-menu-item>
    </RowanContextMenu>
    
    <script type="module">
      import "@rowan-ui/core/context-menu";
      import "@rowan-ui/core/menu-item";
    
      const menu = document.querySelector("rowan-context-menu");
      menu.addEventListener("rowan-change", (event) => {
        console.log(event.detail.value);
      });
    </script>
  );
}
```

## rowan-data-state

Region wrapper for ready, loading, empty, and error chrome. Table and KPI keep their own loading. Does not fetch data.

- Package: `@rowan-ui/core@0.23.4`
- Import: `@rowan-ui/core/data-state`
- React: `RowanDataState` from `@rowan-ui/core/react/data-state`
- Docs: https://2351labs.github.io/rowan/#data-state
- Module: `src/data-state/data-state.js`

### Attributes

| Name | Type | Default | Reflects | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| state | "ready"\|"loading"\|"empty"\|"error" | ready | yes |  |

### Properties

| Name | Type | Default | Reflects | Readonly | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| externalLabelText |  |  |  | yes | Text of any `<label for>` bound to the host. `label`/`for` cannot cross a shadow boundary. |
| messages | RowanDataStateMessages |  |  |  | Property-only fallback copy overrides. |
| state | "ready" \| "loading" \| "empty" \| "error" | ready | yes |  |  |

### Events

None.

### Slots

| Name | Description |
| --- | --- |
| (default) | Ready content |
| actions | Retry or empty actions. Shown for empty and error. |
| empty |  |
| error |  |
| loading |  |

### CSS parts

| Name | Description |
| --- | --- |
| actions |  |
| empty |  |
| error |  |
| loading |  |
| ready |  |

### CSS properties

None.

### Methods

None.

### Examples

### HTML

```html
<!doctype html>
<html lang="en">
  <head>
    <meta charset="utf-8" />
    <title>Data State</title>
    <script type="module">
      import "@rowan-ui/core/tokens";
      import "@rowan-ui/core/tokens/light";
      import "@rowan-ui/core/data-state";
    </script>
  </head>
  <body>
    <rowan-data-state id="fill-rate" state="ready">
  <p>Fill rate is 82% versus a target of 90%.</p>
  <div slot="loading">
    <rowan-spinner label="Loading fill rate"></rowan-spinner>
  </div>
  <rowan-empty-state slot="empty">
    <span slot="title">No fill-rate samples</span>
    <p>Connect a source to populate this panel.</p>
  </rowan-empty-state>
  <p slot="error">The fill-rate query failed.</p>
  <rowan-button slot="actions">Retry</rowan-button>
</rowan-data-state>
  </body>
</html>
```

### React

```tsx
import "@rowan-ui/core/tokens";
import "@rowan-ui/core/tokens/light";
import { RowanDataState } from "@rowan-ui/core/react/data-state";

export function Example() {
  return (
    <RowanDataState id="fill-rate" state="ready">
      <p>Fill rate is 82% versus a target of 90%.</p>
      <div slot="loading">
        <rowan-spinner label="Loading fill rate"></rowan-spinner>
      </div>
      <rowan-empty-state slot="empty">
        <span slot="title">No fill-rate samples</span>
        <p>Connect a source to populate this panel.</p>
      </rowan-empty-state>
      <p slot="error">The fill-rate query failed.</p>
      <rowan-button slot="actions">Retry</rowan-button>
    </RowanDataState>
  );
}
```

```html
        <span>Right</span>
      </div>
```

### Excerpt from documentation/component-examples.js

```html

<rowan-divider></rowan-divider>
<p>South dock stays on the river schedule.</p>

  <span>Left</span>
  <rowan-divider orientation="vertical" style="block-size:1.5rem"></rowan-divider>
  <span>Right</span>
</div>
```

## rowan-donut-chart

Frozen parts-of-a-whole chart. Uses the first series. Negative values are treated as no-data, not slices.

- Package: `@rowan-ui/core@0.23.4`
- Import: `@rowan-ui/core/donut-chart`
- React: `RowanDonutChart` from `@rowan-ui/core/react/donut-chart`
- Docs: https://2351labs.github.io/rowan/#donut-chart
- Module: `src/donut-chart/donut-chart.js`

### Attributes

| Name | Type | Default | Reflects | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| brush | boolean | false | yes | Drag, or Shift+Arrow, to select an x range. Escape clears it. |
| description | string |  | yes |  |
| hidden-series | string |  | yes | Space-separated series or slice ids hidden from the plot. |
| interactive | boolean | false | yes | Each legend item is the slice button for pointer and keyboard activation. No second control list is drawn. |
| label | string |  | yes |  |
| large-series | number |  |  | Downsample drawn marks above this count. The data table keeps every row. |
| locale | string |  | yes |  |
| no-motion | boolean | false | yes | Disables chart motion, including under prefers-reduced-motion. |
| sync-group | string |  |  | Share the axis pointer with charts that use the same group name. |
| variant | "donut"\|"pie" | donut | yes | `pie` fills the hole. Default `donut`. Total stays in the matching table. |

### Properties

| Name | Type | Default | Reflects | Readonly | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| config | RowanDonutChartConfig |  |  |  | Replaces the complete chart configuration. Omitted `variant` resets to donut. |
| description |  |  | yes |  |  |
| externalLabelText |  |  |  | yes | Text of any `<label for>` bound to the host. `label`/`for` cannot cross a shadow boundary. |
| hiddenSeries | string[] |  | yes |  | Ids hidden from the plot. The data table still lists them. |
| interactive |  | false | yes |  |  |
| label |  |  | yes |  |  |
| labels | string[] |  |  | yes | Slice labels. Arrays are property-only. |
| locale |  |  | yes |  |  |
| messages | RowanDonutChartMessages |  |  |  | Property-only built-in message overrides. |
| noMotion |  |  | yes |  |  |
| series | Array<RowanChartSeries> |  |  |  | First series is drawn. Arrays are property-only. |
| tooltipFormatter | ((context: { text: string, event: Event, host: HTMLElement }) => string) \| null |  |  |  | Custom tooltip text. Property-only. |
| valueFormatter | RowanChartValueFormatter \| null |  |  |  |  |
| variant | "donut" \| "pie" | donut | yes |  |  |

### Events

| Name | Detail | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| rowan-brush | startIndex, endIndex, startLabel, endLabel, or cleared. | Selected range. Detail: startIndex, endIndex, startLabel, endLabel, or cleared. |
| rowan-point-activate |  | Fired when a user activates an interactive slice. |
| rowan-point-click | series, index, datum, value. | Cancelable. Detail: series, index, datum, value. |
| rowan-selection-change |  | Cancelable. Follows rowan-point-click when that event is not canceled. |
| rowan-series-toggle | seriesId, hiddenSeries. | Cancelable. Legend visibility toggle. Detail: seriesId, hiddenSeries. |
| rowan-sync | group, index, label. | Shared hover. Detail: group, index, label. |

### Slots

| Name | Description |
| --- | --- |
| description |  |
| label |  |
| tooltip | Custom tooltip content, used when tooltipFormatter is unset. |

### CSS parts

| Name | Description |
| --- | --- |
| control |  |
| hover |  |
| label |  |
| legend |  |
| plot |  |
| slice |  |
| table |  |
| total |  |

### CSS properties

| Name | Description |
| --- | --- |
| --rowan-donut-chart-bg |  |

### Methods

None.

### Examples

### HTML

```html
<!doctype html>
<html lang="en">
  <head>
    <meta charset="utf-8" />
    <title>Donut Chart</title>
    <script type="module">
      import "@rowan-ui/core/tokens";
      import "@rowan-ui/core/tokens/light";
      import "@rowan-ui/core/donut-chart";
    </script>
  </head>
  <body>
    <rowan-donut-chart label="Donut Chart" variant="donut"></rowan-donut-chart>
  </body>
</html>
```

### React


### Attributes

### Properties

| Name | Type | Default | Reflects | Readonly | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |

| messages | RowanDrawerMessages |  |  |  | Property-only built-in message overrides. |

| side | "start" \| "end" | start | yes |  |  |

| Name | Description |
| --- | --- |

| overlay |  |

### HTML

```html
<!doctype html>
<html lang="en">
  <head>
    <meta charset="utf-8" />
    <title>Drawer</title>
    <script type="module">
      import "@rowan-ui/core/tokens";
      import "@rowan-ui/core/tokens/light";
      import "@rowan-ui/core/drawer";
    </script>
  </head>
  <body>
    <rowan-button id="open-notes">Open trail notes</rowan-button>
<rowan-drawer id="trail-notes" side="end">
  <strong slot="title">Evergreen Trail</strong>
  <p>A quiet route through old-growth cedar groves with two scenic overlooks.</p>
</rowan-drawer>

<script type="module">
  const drawer = document.querySelector("#trail-notes");
  document.querySelector("#open-notes").addEventListener("click", () => {
    drawer.open = true;
  });
</script>
  </body>
</html>
```

### React

```tsx
import "@rowan-ui/core/tokens";
import "@rowan-ui/core/tokens/light";
import { RowanDrawer } from "@rowan-ui/core/react/drawer";

// RowanDrawer maps onRowanChange to the rowan-change event.
export function Example() {
  return (
    <rowan-button id="open-notes">Open trail notes</rowan-button>
    <RowanDrawer id="trail-notes" side="end">
      <strong slot="title">Evergreen Trail</strong>
      <p>A quiet route through old-growth cedar groves with two scenic overlooks.</p>
    </RowanDrawer>
    
    <script type="module">
      const drawer = document.querySelector("#trail-notes");
      document.querySelector("#open-notes").addEventListener("click", () => {
        drawer.open = true;
      });
    </script>
  );
}
```


## rowan-dropdown

Triggered dropdown surface. Menu content (`rowan-menu-item`) closes on Tab. Other focusable panel content is tabbed through; Tab at the edge closes.

- Package: `@rowan-ui/core@0.23.4`
- Import: `@rowan-ui/core/dropdown`
- React: `RowanDropdown` from `@rowan-ui/core/react/dropdown`
- Docs: https://2351labs.github.io/rowan/#dropdown
- Module: `src/dropdown/dropdown.js`

### Attributes

| Name | Type | Default | Reflects | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| label | string | Options | yes |  |
| open | boolean | false | yes |  |

### Properties

| Name | Type | Default | Reflects | Readonly | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| externalLabelText |  |  |  | yes | Text of any `<label for>` bound to the host. `label`/`for` cannot cross a shadow boundary. |
| label |  | Options | yes |  |  |
| open |  | false | yes |  |  |

### Events

| Name | Detail | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| rowan-change |  | Fired when a user toggles or dismisses the dropdown |

### Slots

| Name | Description |
| --- | --- |
| (default) | Dropdown content |
| trigger | Optional custom trigger. The default secondary button is used when this slot is empty. |

### CSS parts

| Name | Description |
| --- | --- |
| panel |  |
| trigger |  |

### CSS properties

None.

### Methods

None.

### Examples

### HTML

```html

<html lang="en">
  <head>
    <meta charset="utf-8" />
    <title>Dropdown</title>
    <script type="module">
      import "@rowan-ui/core/tokens";
      import "@rowan-ui/core/tokens/light";
      import "@rowan-ui/core/dropdown";
    </script>
  </head>

    <rowan-dropdown label="Actions">
  <rowan-menu>
    <rowan-menu-item value="edit">Edit</rowan-menu-item>
    <rowan-menu-item value="archive">Archive</rowan-menu-item>
```

| disabled |  | false | yes |  |  |
| externalLabelText |  |  |  | yes | Text of any `<label for>` bound to the host. `label`/`for` cannot cross a shadow boundary. |
| fields | RowanFilterField[] |  |  |  | Filterable fields. Arrays are property-only. |
| filters | Array<RowanFilter \| RowanFilterGroup> |  |  |  | Top-level AND list. Group nodes `{ join, filters }` nest AND/OR. With `for-table`, server mode sends this tree to `getRows` and client mode applies it to the rows. Arrays are property-only. |
| forTable |  |  | yes |  |  |
| label |  |  | yes |  |  |
| messages | RowanFilterBuilderMessages |  |  |  | Property-only built-in message overrides. |
| table |  |  |  |  |  |

### Events

| Name | Detail | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| rowan-filter-change |  | Fired when the user adds, updates, removes, or clears a filter |

### Slots

| --- | --- |
| actions | Controls displayed beside the filter actions |

### CSS parts

| --- | --- |
| add-button |  |

```html
      import "@rowan-ui/core/filter-builder";
    </script>
  </head>
```

### React

```tsx
import "@rowan-ui/core/tokens";
import "@rowan-ui/core/tokens/light";
import { RowanFilterBuilder } from "@rowan-ui/core/react/filter-builder";

// RowanFilterBuilder maps onRowanFilterChange to the rowan-filter-change event.
export function Example() {
  return (
    <rowan-app-layout>
      <div slot="header">Orders</div>
      <rowan-data-state state="ready">
        <rowan-table>
          <RowanFilterBuilder slot="toolbar" appearance="toolbar" />
        </rowan-table>
        <p slot="empty">No matching rows.</p>
      </rowan-data-state>
    </rowan-app-layout>
  );
}
```

### Excerpt from documentation/app.js (FILTER_BUILDER_SNIPPET)

```html
<rowan-table id="members-table">
  <rowan-filter-builder id="member-filters" slot="toolbar" appearance="toolbar"></rowan-filter-builder>
</rowan-table>

<script type="module">
  import { applyFilters } from "@rowan-ui/core/filter-builder";

  const rows = [
    { id: "1", name: "Ada", role: "Admin" },
    { id: "2", name: "Alan", role: "Editor" },
  ];
  const table = document.querySelector("#members-table");
  const filters = document.querySelector("#member-filters");

  table.config = {
    rowId: "id",
    columns: [
      { id: "name", header: "Name" },
      { id: "role", header: "Role" },
    ],
    rows,
  };

  filters.fields = [
    { id: "name", label: "Name", operators: ["contains"] },
    { id: "role", label: "Role", options: ["Admin", "Editor"], operators: ["equals"] },
  ];

  filters.addEventListener("rowan-filter-change", (event) => {
    table.rows = applyFilters(rows, event.detail.filters, filters.fields);
  });
</script>
```

### HTML

```html
<!doctype html>
<html lang="en">
  <head>
    <meta charset="utf-8" />
    <title>Form Wizard</title>
    <script type="module">
      import "@rowan-ui/core/tokens";
      import "@rowan-ui/core/tokens/light";
      import "@rowan-ui/core/form-wizard";
    </script>
  </head>
  <body>
    <rowan-form-wizard id="onboarding-wizard">
  <section slot="step-account" data-step-label="Account">
    <rowan-text-field name="organization" label="Organization" required></rowan-text-field>
  </section>
  <section slot="step-review" data-step-label="Review">
    Confirm the account details before completing setup.
  </section>
</rowan-form-wizard>

<script type="module">
  const wizard = document.querySelector("#onboarding-wizard");
  wizard.steps = [
    { id: "account", label: "Account" },
    { id: "review", label: "Review" },
  ];

  wizard.addEventListener("rowan-invalid", (event) => {
    console.log(event.detail.errors);
  });
</script>
  </body>
</html>
```

### React

```tsx
import "@rowan-ui/core/tokens";
import "@rowan-ui/core/tokens/light";
import { RowanFormWizard } from "@rowan-ui/core/react/form-wizard";

// RowanFormWizard maps onRowanComplete to the rowan-complete event.
export function Example() {
  return (
    <RowanFormWizard id="onboarding-wizard">
      <section slot="step-account" data-step-label="Account">
        <rowan-text-field name="organization" label="Organization" required></rowan-text-field>
      </section>
      <section slot="step-review" data-step-label="Review">
        Confirm the account details before completing setup.
      </section>
    </RowanFormWizard>
    
    <script type="module">
      const wizard = document.querySelector("#onboarding-wizard");
      wizard.steps = [
        { id: "account", label: "Account" },
        { id: "review", label: "Review" },
      ];
    
      wizard.addEventListener("rowan-invalid", (event) => {
        console.log(event.detail.errors);
      });
    </script>
  );
}
```

## rowan-funnel-chart

One-series stage chart. Does not auto-sort. Negatives and null are no-data. `pyramid` puts stage 0 at the bottom; `cone` tapers the last stage to a point.

- Package: `@rowan-ui/core@0.23.4`
- Import: `@rowan-ui/core/funnel-chart`
- React: `RowanFunnelChart` from `@rowan-ui/core/react/funnel-chart`
- Docs: https://2351labs.github.io/rowan/#funnel-chart
- Module: `src/funnel-chart/funnel-chart.js`

### Attributes

| Name | Type | Default | Reflects | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| brush | boolean | false | yes | Drag, or Shift+Arrow, to select an x range. Escape clears it. |
| description | string |  | yes |  |
| hidden-series | string |  | yes | Space-separated series or slice ids hidden from the plot. |
| interactive | boolean | false | yes |  |
| label | string |  | yes |  |
| large-series | number |  |  | Downsample drawn marks above this count. The data table keeps every row. |
| locale | string |  | yes |  |
| no-motion | boolean | false | yes | Disables chart motion, including under prefers-reduced-motion. |
| sync-group | string |  |  | Share the axis pointer with charts that use the same group name. |
| variant | "funnel"\|"cone"\|"pyramid" | funnel | yes | Default `funnel`. |

### Properties

| Name | Type | Default | Reflects | Readonly | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| config | RowanFunnelChartConfig |  |  |  | Replaces the complete chart configuration. Omitted `variant` resets to funnel. |
| description |  |  | yes |  |  |
| externalLabelText |  |  |  | yes | Text of any `<label for>` bound to the host. `label`/`for` cannot cross a shadow boundary. |
| hiddenSeries | string[] |  | yes |  | Ids hidden from the plot. The data table still lists them. |
| interactive |  | false | yes |  |  |
| label |  |  | yes |  |  |
| labels | string[] |  |  | yes | Stage labels. Arrays are property-only. |
| locale |  |  | yes |  |  |
| messages | RowanFunnelChartMessages |  |  |  | Property-only built-in message overrides. |
| noMotion |  |  | yes |  |  |
| series | Array<RowanChartSeries> |  |  |  | First series is drawn. Arrays are property-only. |
| tooltipFormatter | ((context: { text: string, event: Event, host: HTMLElement }) => string) \| null |  |  |  | Custom tooltip text. Property-only. |
| valueFormatter | RowanChartValueFormatter \| null |  |  |  |  |
| variant | "funnel" \| "cone" \| "pyramid" | funnel | yes |  |  |

### Events

| Name | Detail | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| rowan-brush | startIndex, endIndex, startLabel, endLabel, or cleared. | Selected range. Detail: startIndex, endIndex, startLabel, endLabel, or cleared. |
| rowan-point-activate |  | Fired when a user activates an interactive stage. |
| rowan-point-click | series, index, datum, value. | Cancelable. Detail: series, index, datum, value. |
| rowan-selection-change |  | Cancelable. Follows rowan-point-click when that event is not canceled. |
| rowan-series-toggle | seriesId, hiddenSeries. | Cancelable. Legend visibility toggle. Detail: seriesId, hiddenSeries. |
| rowan-sync | group, index, label. | Shared hover. Detail: group, index, label. |

### Slots

| Name | Description |
| --- | --- |
| description |  |
| label |  |
| tooltip | Custom tooltip content, used when tooltipFormatter is unset. |

### CSS parts

| Name | Description |
| --- | --- |
| control |  |
| hover |  |
| plot |  |
| stage |  |
| table |  |

### CSS properties

| Name | Description |
| --- | --- |
| --rowan-funnel-chart-bg |  |

### Methods

None.

### Examples

### HTML

```html
  <head>
    <meta charset="utf-8" />
    <title>Funnel Chart</title>
    <script type="module">
      import "@rowan-ui/core/tokens";
      import "@rowan-ui/core/tokens/light";
      import "@rowan-ui/core/funnel-chart";
    </script>
  </head>
  <body>
    <rowan-funnel-chart label="Funnel Chart" variant="funnel"></rowan-funnel-chart>
  </body>

```

## rowan-gauge-chart

Compact speedometer gauge: ranges, min/max, actual, and optional target. Separate host from bullet and donut charts.

- Package: `@rowan-ui/core@0.23.4`
- Import: `@rowan-ui/core/gauge-chart`
- React: `RowanGaugeChart` from `@rowan-ui/core/react/gauge-chart`
- Docs: https://2351labs.github.io/rowan/#gauge-chart
- Module: `src/gauge-chart/gauge-chart.js`

### Attributes

| Name | Type | Default | Reflects | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| brush | boolean | false | yes | Drag, or Shift+Arrow, to select an x range. Escape clears it. |
| hidden-series | string |  | yes | Space-separated series or slice ids hidden from the plot. |
| label | string |  | yes |  |
| large-series | number |  |  | Downsample drawn marks above this count. The data table keeps every row. |
| locale | string |  | yes |  |
| max | number | 100 | yes |  |
| min | number | 0 | yes |  |
| no-motion | boolean | false | yes | Disables chart motion, including under prefers-reduced-motion. |
| sync-group | string |  |  | Share the axis pointer with charts that use the same group name. |

### Properties

| Name | Type | Default | Reflects | Readonly | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| externalLabelText |  |  |  | yes | Text of any `<label for>` bound to the host. `label`/`for` cannot cross a shadow boundary. |
| hiddenSeries | string[] |  | yes |  | `needle` hides the needle, `target` hides the target tick, and a range tone hides that band. The data table still lists them. |
| label |  |  | yes |  |  |
| locale |  |  | yes |  |  |
| max |  | 100 | yes |  |  |
| messages | RowanGaugeChartMessages |  |  |  | Property-only built-in message overrides. |
| min |  | 0 | yes |  |  |
| noMotion |  |  | yes |  |  |
| ranges | RowanGaugeChartRange[] |  |  |  | Qualitative bands. Arrays are property-only. |
| target | number \| null |  |  |  | Target tick. Property-only. Null hides the tick. |
| tooltipFormatter | ((context: { text: string, event: Event, host: HTMLElement }) => string) \| null |  |  |  | Custom tooltip text. Property-only. |
| value | number \| null |  |  |  | Actual measure. Property-only. Null is no-data. |

### Events

| Name | Detail | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| rowan-brush | startIndex, endIndex, startLabel, endLabel, or cleared. | Selected range. Detail: startIndex, endIndex, startLabel, endLabel, or cleared. |
| rowan-point-click | series, index, datum, value. | Cancelable. Detail: series, index, datum, value. |
| rowan-selection-change |  | Cancelable. Follows rowan-point-click when that event is not canceled. |
| rowan-series-toggle | seriesId, hiddenSeries. | Cancelable. Legend visibility toggle. Detail: seriesId, hiddenSeries. |
| rowan-sync | group, index, label. | Shared hover. Detail: group, index, label. |

### Slots

| Name | Description |
| --- | --- |
| tooltip | Custom tooltip content, used when tooltipFormatter is unset. |

### CSS parts

| Name | Description |
| --- | --- |
| chart |  |
| hover |  |
| hub |  |
| needle |  |
| plot |  |
| range |  |
| readout |  |
| table |  |
| target |  |
| tick-label |  |
| track |  |

### CSS properties

| Name | Description |
| --- | --- |
| --rowan-gauge-chart-needle |  |
| --rowan-gauge-chart-range |  |
| --rowan-gauge-chart-target |  |
| --rowan-gauge-chart-track |  |

### Methods

None.

### Examples

### HTML

```html
<!doctype html>
<html lang="en">
  <head>
    <meta charset="utf-8" />
    <title>Gauge Chart</title>
    <script type="module">
      import "@rowan-ui/core/tokens";
      import "@rowan-ui/core/tokens/light";
      import "@rowan-ui/core/gauge-chart";
    </script>
  </head>
  <body>
    <rowan-kpi-card label="Utilization" tone="warning" delta-label="vs target">
  <rowan-gauge-chart slot="chart" label="Utilization versus target" min="0" max="100"></rowan-gauge-chart>
</rowan-kpi-card>

<script type="module">
  import "@rowan-ui/core/kpi-card";
  import "@rowan-ui/core/gauge-chart";

  const card = document.querySelector("rowan-kpi-card");
  const chart = document.querySelector("rowan-gauge-chart");
  card.value = 72;
  card.delta = -8;
  chart.value = 72;
  chart.target = 80;
  chart.ranges = [
    { from: 0, to: 50, label: "Low", tone: "danger" },
    { from: 50, to: 80, label: "Fair", tone: "warning" },
    { from: 80, to: 100, label: "Good", tone: "success" },
  ];
</script>
  </body>
</html>
```

### React

```tsx

// RowanGaugeChart maps onRowanBrush to the rowan-brush event.
export function Example() {
  return (
    <rowan-kpi-card label="Utilization" tone="warning" delta-label="vs target">
      <RowanGaugeChart slot="chart" label="Utilization versus target" min="0" max="100" />
    </rowan-kpi-card>
    
    <script type="module">
      import "@rowan-ui/core/kpi-card";
      import "@rowan-ui/core/gauge-chart";
    
      const card = document.querySelector("rowan-kpi-card");
      const chart = document.querySelector("rowan-gauge-chart");
      card.value = 72;
      card.delta = -8;
      chart.value = 72;
      chart.target = 80;
      chart.ranges = [
        { from: 0, to: 50, label: "Low", tone: "danger" },
        { from: 50, to: 80, label: "Fair", tone: "warning" },
        { from: 80, to: 100, label: "Good", tone: "success" },
      ];
    </script>
  );
}
```
