## rowan-heatmap-chart

Categorical heatmap. Single-hue intensity via fill-opacity. Null is empty / no-data. Accepts a matrix or `{ x, y, value }` / `{ row, column, value }` points.

- Package: `@rowan-ui/core@0.23.4`
- Import: `@rowan-ui/core/heatmap-chart`
- React: `RowanHeatmapChart` from `@rowan-ui/core/react/heatmap-chart`
- Docs: https://2351labs.github.io/rowan/#heatmap-chart
- Module: `src/heatmap-chart/heatmap-chart.js`

### Attributes

| Name | Type | Default | Reflects | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| brush | boolean | false | yes | Drag, or Shift+Arrow, to select an x range. Escape clears it. |
| description | string |  | yes |  |
| hidden-series | string |  | yes | Space-separated series or slice ids hidden from the plot. |
| interactive | boolean | false | yes |  |
| label | string |  | yes |  |
| large-series | number |  |  | Downsample drawn marks above this count. The data table keeps every row. |
| locale | string |  | yes |  |
| no-motion | boolean | false | yes | Disables chart motion, including under prefers-reduced-motion. |
| sync-group | string |  |  | Share the axis pointer with charts that use the same group name. |

### Properties

| Name | Type | Default | Reflects | Readonly | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| columns | string[] |  |  |  | Column labels. Arrays are property-only. |
| config | RowanHeatmapChartConfig |  |  |  | Replaces the complete chart configuration. Reads return the active matrix or points data form. |
| description |  |  | yes |  |  |
| externalLabelText |  |  |  | yes | Text of any `<label for>` bound to the host. `label`/`for` cannot cross a shadow boundary. |
| hiddenSeries | string[] |  | yes |  | Ids hidden from the plot. The data table still lists them. |
| interactive |  | false | yes |  |  |
| label |  |  | yes |  |  |
| locale |  |  | yes |  |  |
| messages | RowanHeatmapChartMessages |  |  |  | Property-only built-in message overrides. |
| noMotion |  |  | yes |  |  |
| points | RowanHeatmapChartPoint[] |  |  |  | Optional `{ x, y, value }` or `{ column, row, value }` triples. Arrays are property-only. |
| rows | string[] |  |  |  | Row labels. Arrays are property-only. |
| tooltipFormatter | ((context: { text: string, event: Event, host: HTMLElement }) => string) \| null |  |  |  | Custom tooltip text. Property-only. |
| valueFormatter | RowanChartValueFormatter \| null |  |  |  | Formats table and hover values. Functions are property-only. |
| values | Array<Array<number \| null>> |  |  |  | Matrix of cell values. Arrays are property-only. |

### Events

| Name | Detail | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| rowan-brush | startIndex, endIndex, startLabel, endLabel, or cleared. | Selected range. Detail: startIndex, endIndex, startLabel, endLabel, or cleared. |
| rowan-point-activate |  | Fired when a user activates an interactive cell. |
| rowan-point-click | series, index, datum, value. | Cancelable. Detail: series, index, datum, value. |
| rowan-selection-change |  | Cancelable. Follows rowan-point-click when that event is not canceled. |
| rowan-series-toggle | seriesId, hiddenSeries. | Cancelable. Legend visibility toggle. Detail: seriesId, hiddenSeries. |
| rowan-sync | group, index, label. | Shared hover. Detail: group, index, label. |

### Slots

| Name | Description |
| --- | --- |
| description |  |
| label |  |
| tooltip | Custom tooltip content, used when tooltipFormatter is unset. |

### CSS parts

| Name | Description |
| --- | --- |
| cell |  |
| control |  |
| hover |  |
| plot |  |
| table |  |

### CSS properties

| Name | Description |
| --- | --- |
| --rowan-heatmap-chart-bg |  |

### Methods

None.

### Examples

### HTML

```html
    <meta charset="utf-8" />
    <title>Heatmap Chart</title>
    <script type="module">

      import "@rowan-ui/core/tokens/light";
      import "@rowan-ui/core/heatmap-chart";
    </script>
```

## rowan-icon

Declarative SVG icon registered by an individual `@rowan-ui/icons/elements/*` import.

- Package: `@rowan-ui/icons@0.23.4`
- Import: `@rowan-ui/icons/element`
- React: `RowanIcon` from `@rowan-ui/icons/react/icon`
- Docs: https://2351labs.github.io/rowan/#icon
- Module: `src/element.js`

Each glyph is its own module. `import "@rowan-ui/icons/elements/<name>"` registers `<rowan-icon>` and that name. `@rowan-ui/icons/element` registers the class only.

### Attributes

| Name | Type | Default | Reflects | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| label | string |  | yes |  |
| name | string |  | yes |  |

| stroke-width | string |  | yes |  |
| tone | "none"\|"info"\|"success"\|"warning"\|"danger" |  | yes |  |

| Name | Type | Default | Reflects | Readonly | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| label |  |  | yes |  |  |
| name |  |  | yes |  |  |
| size |  |  | yes |  |  |
| strokeWidth |  |  | yes |  |  |
| tone | "none" \| "info" \| "success" \| "warning" \| "danger" |  | yes |  |  |

### Events

None.

### Slots

None.

### CSS parts

| Name | Description |
| --- | --- |
| icon |  |

### CSS properties

None.

### Methods

None.

### Examples

## rowan-image

Image display. Overlay and caption are slots. Optional href is a real link around the image, not around overlay actions.

- Package: `@rowan-ui/core@0.23.4`
- Import: `@rowan-ui/core/image`
- React: `RowanImage` from `@rowan-ui/core/react/image`
- Docs: https://2351labs.github.io/rowan/#image
- Module: `src/image/image.js`

### Attributes

| Name | Type | Default | Reflects | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| alt | string |  | yes |  |
| fit | "cover"\|"contain" | cover | yes |  |
| href | string |  | yes |  |
| loading | "lazy"\|"eager" | lazy | yes |  |
| src | string |  | yes |  |

### Properties

| Name | Type | Default | Reflects | Readonly | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| alt |  |  | yes |  |  |
| externalLabelText |  |  |  | yes | Text of any `<label for>` bound to the host. `label`/`for` cannot cross a shadow boundary. |
| fit | "cover" \| "contain" | cover | yes |  |  |
| href |  |  | yes |  |  |
| loading | "lazy" \| "eager" | lazy | yes |  |  |
| src |  |  | yes |  |  |

### Events

None.

### Slots

| Name | Description |
| --- | --- |
| caption |  |
| fallback | Shown when src is missing or the image fails. |
| overlay | Actions and badges on top of the image. Not inside the link. |

### CSS parts

| Name | Description |
| --- | --- |
| caption |  |
| control |  |
| fallback |  |
| frame |  |
| image |  |
| overlay |  |

### CSS properties

| Name | Description |
| --- | --- |
| --rowan-image-aspect |  |
| --rowan-image-bg |  |
| --rowan-image-fg |  |
| --rowan-image-radius |  |

### Methods

None.

### Examples

### HTML

```html
<!doctype html>
<html lang="en">
  <head>
    <meta charset="utf-8" />
    <title>Image</title>
    <script type="module">
      import "@rowan-ui/core/tokens";
      import "@rowan-ui/core/tokens/light";
      import "@rowan-ui/core/image";
    </script>
  </head>
  <body>
    <rowan-image
  src="north-yard.svg"
  alt="North yard loading docks at dusk"
  href="https://example.test/cameras/north-yard"
  fit="cover"
  loading="eager"
>
  <rowan-badge slot="overlay" tone="warning">Needs review</rowan-badge>
  <span slot="caption">North yard · live still</span>
</rowan-image>

<rowan-image src="missing-camera.jpg" alt="South dock camera offline">
  <span slot="fallback">Still unavailable</span>
  <span slot="caption">Fallback when the still fails</span>
</rowan-image>
  </body>
</html>
```

### React

```tsx
import "@rowan-ui/core/tokens";
import "@rowan-ui/core/tokens/light";
import { RowanImage } from "@rowan-ui/core/react/image";

export function Example() {
  return (
    <RowanImage
      src="north-yard.svg"
      alt="North yard loading docks at dusk"
      href="https://example.test/cameras/north-yard"
      fit="cover"
      loading="eager"
    >
      <rowan-badge slot="overlay" tone="warning">Needs review</rowan-badge>
      <span slot="caption">North yard · live still</span>
    </RowanImage>
    
    <RowanImage src="missing-camera.jpg" alt="South dock camera offline">
      <span slot="fallback">Still unavailable</span>
      <span slot="caption">Fallback when the still fails</span>
    </RowanImage>
  );
}
```


## rowan-kpi-card

Frozen dashboard stat tile. Value and delta stay property-only. Inline-size container: compact below 10rem, roomy from 22rem. A slotted gauge sits immediately beside the metrics except below 10rem. Does not change chart kind or reformat the value.

- Package: `@rowan-ui/core@0.23.4`
- Import: `@rowan-ui/core/kpi-card`
- React: `RowanKpiCard` from `@rowan-ui/core/react/kpi-card`
- Docs: https://2351labs.github.io/rowan/#kpi-card
- Module: `src/kpi-card/kpi-card.js`

### Attributes

| Name | Type | Default | Reflects | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| delta-label | string |  | yes |  |
| hidden-series | string |  | yes | Space-separated series or slice ids hidden from the plot. |
| label | string |  | yes |  |
| loading | boolean | false | yes |  |
| locale | string |  | yes |  |
| no-motion | boolean | false | yes | Disables chart motion, including under prefers-reduced-motion. |
| tone | "neutral"\|"info"\|"success"\|"warning"\|"danger" | neutral | yes |  |

### Properties

| Name | Type | Default | Reflects | Readonly | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| delta | number \| null |  |  |  | Signed change. Property-only. Null hides the delta. |
| deltaLabel |  |  | yes |  |  |
| externalLabelText |  |  |  | yes | Text of any `<label for>` bound to the host. `label`/`for` cannot cross a shadow boundary. |
| hiddenSeries | string[] |  | yes |  | Ids hidden from the plot. The data table still lists them. |
| label |  |  | yes |  |  |
| loading |  | false | yes |  |  |
| locale |  |  | yes |  |  |
| messages | RowanKpiCardMessages |  |  |  | Property-only built-in message overrides. |
| noMotion |  |  | yes |  |  |
| tone | "neutral" \| "info" \| "success" \| "warning" \| "danger" | neutral | yes |  |  |
| tooltipFormatter | ((context: { text: string, event: Event, host: HTMLElement }) => string) \| null |  |  |  | Custom tooltip text. Property-only. |
| value | number \| string \| null |  |  |  | Displayed metric. Property-only. |

### Events

| Name | Detail | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| rowan-point-click | series, index, datum, value. | Cancelable. Detail: series, index, datum, value. |
| rowan-selection-change |  | Cancelable. Follows rowan-point-click when that event is not canceled. |
| rowan-series-toggle | seriesId, hiddenSeries. | Cancelable. Legend visibility toggle. Detail: seriesId, hiddenSeries. |

### Slots

| Name | Description |
| --- | --- |
| (default) | Description or extra copy |
| chart | Optional compact chart |
| icon | Optional leading icon |
| tooltip | Custom tooltip content, used when tooltipFormatter is unset. |

### CSS parts

| Name | Description |
| --- | --- |
| body |  |
| card |  |
| chart |  |
| delta |  |
| description |  |
| icon |  |
| label |  |
| value |  |

### CSS properties

| Name | Description |
| --- | --- |
| --rowan-kpi-card-bg |  |
| --rowan-kpi-card-border |  |
| --rowan-kpi-card-chart-height |  |
| --rowan-kpi-card-fg |  |
| --rowan-kpi-card-gap |  |
| --rowan-kpi-card-min-inline-size |  |
| --rowan-kpi-card-padding |  |
| --rowan-kpi-card-value-size |  |

### Methods

None.

### Examples

### HTML

```html
<!doctype html>
<html lang="en">
  <head>
    <meta charset="utf-8" />
    <title>Kpi Card</title>
    <script type="module">
      import "@rowan-ui/core/tokens";
      import "@rowan-ui/core/tokens/light";
      import "@rowan-ui/core/kpi-card";
    </script>
  </head>
  <body>
    <rowan-kpi-card label="Fill rate" tone="success" delta-label="vs target">
  <rowan-bullet-chart slot="chart" label="Fill rate versus target"></rowan-bullet-chart>
</rowan-kpi-card>

<script type="module">
  import "@rowan-ui/core/kpi-card";
  import "@rowan-ui/core/bullet-chart";

  const card = document.querySelector("rowan-kpi-card");
  const chart = document.querySelector("rowan-bullet-chart");
  card.value = 82;
  card.delta = -8;
  chart.value = 82;
  chart.target = 90;
  chart.ranges = [
    { from: 0, to: 60, label: "Poor", tone: "danger" },
    { from: 60, to: 80, label: "Fair", tone: "warning" },
    { from: 80, to: 100, label: "Good", tone: "success" },
  ];
</script>
  </body>
</html>
```

### React

```tsx
import "@rowan-ui/core/tokens";
import "@rowan-ui/core/tokens/light";
import { RowanKpiCard } from "@rowan-ui/core/react/kpi-card";

// RowanKpiCard maps onRowanPointClick to the rowan-point-click event.
export function Example() {
  return (
    <RowanKpiCard label="Fill rate" tone="success" delta-label="vs target">
      <rowan-bullet-chart slot="chart" label="Fill rate versus target"></rowan-bullet-chart>
    </RowanKpiCard>
    
    <script type="module">
      import "@rowan-ui/core/kpi-card";
      import "@rowan-ui/core/bullet-chart";
    
      const card = document.querySelector("rowan-kpi-card");
      const chart = document.querySelector("rowan-bullet-chart");
      card.value = 82;
      card.delta = -8;
      chart.value = 82;
      chart.target = 90;
      chart.ranges = [
        { from: 0, to: 60, label: "Poor", tone: "danger" },
        { from: 60, to: 80, label: "Fair", tone: "warning" },
        { from: 80, to: 100, label: "Good", tone: "success" },
      ];
    </script>
  );
}
```

### Excerpt from documentation/app.js (KPI_CARD_SNIPPET)

```html
  label="Open incidents"
  tone="warning"
  delta-label="vs last week"
></rowan-kpi-card>

  const card = document.querySelector("rowan-kpi-card");
  card.value = 19;
  card.delta = -4;

```


## rowan-link

## rowan-listbox

Accessible single- or multi-selection list control.

- Package: `@rowan-ui/core@0.23.4`
- Import: `@rowan-ui/core/listbox`
- React: `RowanListbox` from `@rowan-ui/core/react/listbox`
- Docs: https://2351labs.github.io/rowan/#listbox
- Module: `src/listbox/listbox.js`

### Attributes

| Name | Type | Default | Reflects | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| disabled | boolean | false | yes |  |
| label | string |  | yes |  |
| name | string |  | yes |  |
| required | boolean | false | yes |  |
| selection | "single"\|"multiple" | single | yes |  |
| value | string |  | yes |  |

### Properties

| Name | Type | Default | Reflects | Readonly | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| disabled |  | false | yes |  |  |
| externalLabelText |  |  |  | yes | Text of any `<label for>` bound to the host. `label`/`for` cannot cross a shadow boundary. |
| label |  |  | yes |  |  |
| name |  |  | yes |  |  |
| required |  | false | yes |  |  |
| selected | string[] |  |  |  | Selected option values. Arrays are property-only. |
| selectedOptions | RowanOption[] |  |  | yes |  |
| selection | "single" \| "multiple" | single | yes |  |  |
| value |  |  | yes |  |  |

### Events

| Name | Detail | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| rowan-change |  | Fired when user interaction changes selection |

### Slots

| Name | Description |
| --- | --- |
| (default) | rowan-option children |

### CSS parts

| Name | Description |
| --- | --- |
| listbox |  |

### CSS properties

| Name | Description |
| --- | --- |
| --rowan-listbox-bg |  |
| --rowan-listbox-border |  |

### Methods

| Name | Description |
| --- | --- |
| clearSelection() |  |
| focusFirstOption() | Moves focus to the first option that can receive it. |

### Examples

### HTML

```html
<!doctype html>
<html lang="en">
  <head>
    <meta charset="utf-8" />
    <title>Listbox</title>
    <script type="module">
      import "@rowan-ui/core/tokens";
      import "@rowan-ui/core/tokens/light";
      import "@rowan-ui/core/listbox";
    </script>
  </head>
  <body>
    <rowan-listbox id="team-list" name="team" label="Teams" selection="multiple">
  <rowan-option value="design">Design</rowan-option>
  <rowan-option value="engineering">Engineering</rowan-option>
  <rowan-option value="operations">Operations</rowan-option>
</rowan-listbox>

<script type="module">
  import "@rowan-ui/core/listbox";

  const listbox = document.querySelector("#team-list");
  listbox.selected = ["design", "operations"];

  listbox.addEventListener("rowan-change", (event) => {
    console.log(event.detail.selected);
  });
</script>
  </body>
</html>
```

### React

```tsx
import "@rowan-ui/core/tokens";
import "@rowan-ui/core/tokens/light";
import { RowanListbox } from "@rowan-ui/core/react/listbox";

// RowanListbox maps onRowanChange to the rowan-change event.
export function Example() {
  return (
    <RowanListbox id="team-list" name="team" label="Teams" selection="multiple">
      <rowan-option value="design">Design</rowan-option>
      <rowan-option value="engineering">Engineering</rowan-option>
      <rowan-option value="operations">Operations</rowan-option>
    </RowanListbox>
    
    <script type="module">
      import "@rowan-ui/core/listbox";
    
      const listbox = document.querySelector("#team-list");
      listbox.selected = ["design", "operations"];
    
      listbox.addEventListener("rowan-change", (event) => {
        console.log(event.detail.selected);
      });
    </script>
  );
}
```

### Excerpt from documentation/app.js (LISTBOX_SNIPPET)


## rowan-maplibre-map

Optional MapLibre map with application-owned styles and accessible location alternatives.

- Package: `@rowan-ui/maplibre@0.23.4`
- Import: `@rowan-ui/maplibre/map`
- React: `RowanMapLibreMap` from `@rowan-ui/maplibre/react/map`
- Docs: https://2351labs.github.io/rowan/#maplibre-map
- Module: `src/map/map.js`

Install the `maplibre-gl` peer next to `@rowan-ui/maplibre`. The map registers from `@rowan-ui/maplibre/map`.

### Attributes

| Name | Type | Default | Reflects | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| description | string |  | yes |  |
| label | string |  | yes |  |
| no-provider-styles | boolean | false | yes | Do not inject `maplibre-gl.css` into the shadow root. |

### Properties

| Name | Type | Default | Reflects | Readonly | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| attribution | RowanMapAttributionInput |  |  |  | Application-owned provider attribution. This property is never reflected to an attribute. |
| description |  |  | yes |  |  |
| label |  |  | yes |  |  |
| layers | Array<RowanMapLayer> |  |  |  | Property-only marker layer metadata. |
| locations | Array<RowanMapLocation> |  |  |  | Property-only coordinate records. |
| maplibre | object \| null |  |  |  | Optional MapLibre module injection for controlled loading and tests. |
| mapStyle | string \| Record<string, unknown> \| null |  |  |  | Application-owned MapLibre style. This property is never reflected to an attribute. |
| noProviderStyles |  |  | yes |  |  |

### Events

| Name | Detail | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| rowan-layer-change |  | Fired when a user changes a visible marker layer. |
| rowan-location-activate |  | Fired when a user activates a map marker, list item, or table action. |

### Slots

None.

### CSS parts

| Name | Description |
| --- | --- |
| attribution |  |
| control |  |
| description |  |
| label |  |
| layers |  |
| list |  |
| map |  |
| marker |  |
| table |  |

### CSS properties

| Name | Description |
| --- | --- |
| --rowan-maplibre-map-bg |  |
| --rowan-maplibre-map-border |  |
| --rowan-maplibre-map-height |  |
| --rowan-maplibre-map-marker-bg |  |

### Methods

None.

### Examples

### HTML

```html
<!doctype html>
<html lang="en">
  <head>
    <meta charset="utf-8" />
    <title>Maplibre Map</title>
    <script type="module">
      import "@rowan-ui/core/tokens";
      import "@rowan-ui/core/tokens/light";
      import "@rowan-ui/maplibre/map";
    </script>
  </head>
  <body>
    <rowan-maplibre-map
  id="dispatch-coverage"
  label="Dispatch coverage"
  description="Scheduled field work by coordinate."
></rowan-maplibre-map>

<script type="module">
  import "@rowan-ui/core/tokens";
  import "@rowan-ui/maplibre/map";

  const map = document.querySelector("#dispatch-coverage");
  map.mapStyle = "https://tiles.openfreemap.org/styles/liberty";
  map.attribution = [
    { label: "OpenFreeMap", href: "https://openfreemap.org/" },
    { label: "© OpenMapTiles", href: "https://www.openmaptiles.org/" },
    {
      label: "Data from OpenStreetMap",
      href: "https://www.openstreetmap.org/copyright",
    },
  ];
  map.layers = [{ id: "scheduled", label: "Scheduled work", visible: true }];
  map.locations = [
    {
      id: "dispatch-17",
      label: "Generator inspection",
      latitude: 47.6062,
      longitude: -122.3321,
      description: "Priority inspection",
      layerId: "scheduled",
    },
  ];

  map.addEventListener("rowan-location-activate", (event) => {
    console.log(event.detail);
  });
</script>
  </body>
</html>
```

### React

```tsx
import "@rowan-ui/core/tokens";

export function Example() {
  return (
    <RowanMapLibreMap
      id="dispatch-coverage"

      description="Scheduled field work by coordinate."
     />
    
    <script type="module">
      import "@rowan-ui/core/tokens";
      import "@rowan-ui/maplibre/map";
    
      const map = document.querySelector("#dispatch-coverage");
      map.mapStyle = "https://tiles.openfreemap.org/styles/liberty";
      map.attribution = [
        { label: "OpenFreeMap", href: "https://openfreemap.org/" },
        { label: "© OpenMapTiles", href: "https://www.openmaptiles.org/" },
        {
          label: "Data from OpenStreetMap",
          href: "https://www.openstreetmap.org/copyright",
        },
      ];
      map.layers = [{ id: "scheduled", label: "Scheduled work", visible: true }];
      map.locations = [
        {
          id: "dispatch-17",
          label: "Generator inspection",
          latitude: 47.6062,
          longitude: -122.3321,
          description: "Priority inspection",
          layerId: "scheduled",
        },
      ];
    
      map.addEventListener("rowan-location-activate", (event) => {
        console.log(event.detail);
      });
    </script>
  );
}
```

## rowan-multi-select-combobox

Filterable multi-select control with removable selected values.

- Package: `@rowan-ui/core@0.23.4`
- Import: `@rowan-ui/core/multi-select-combobox`
- React: `RowanMultiSelectCombobox` from `@rowan-ui/core/react/multi-select-combobox`
- Docs: https://2351labs.github.io/rowan/#multi-select-combobox
- Module: `src/multi-select-combobox/multi-select-combobox.js`

### Attributes

| Name | Type | Default | Reflects | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| disabled | boolean | false | yes |  |
| label | string |  | yes |  |
| locale | string |  | yes |  |
| name | string |  | yes |  |
| open | boolean | false | yes |  |
| placeholder | string |  | yes |  |
| query | string |  | yes |  |
| required | boolean | false | yes |  |

### Properties

| Name | Type | Default | Reflects | Readonly | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| disabled |  | false | yes |  |  |
| externalLabelText |  |  |  | yes | Text of any `<label for>` bound to the host. `label`/`for` cannot cross a shadow boundary. |
| label |  |  | yes |  |  |
| locale |  |  | yes |  |  |
| messages | RowanMultiSelectComboboxMessages |  |  |  | Property-only built-in message overrides. |
| name |  |  | yes |  |  |
| open |  | false | yes |  |  |
| options | Array<string \| { value: string, label?: string, disabled?: boolean }> |  |  |  | Available options. Arrays are property-only. |
| placeholder |  |  | yes |  |  |
| query |  |  | yes |  |  |
| required |  | false | yes |  |  |
| selected | string[] |  |  |  | Selected option values. Arrays are property-only. |
| selectedOptions |  |  |  | yes |  |

### Events

| Name | Detail | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| rowan-change |  | Fired when a user adds or removes a selected value |

### Slots

None.

### CSS parts

| Name | Description |
| --- | --- |
| chip |  |
| chips |  |
| control |  |
| empty |  |
| input |  |
| listbox |  |

### CSS properties

| Name | Description |
| --- | --- |
| --rowan-multi-select-combobox-bg |  |
| --rowan-multi-select-combobox-border |  |

### Methods

None.

### Examples

### HTML

```html
<!doctype html>
<html lang="en">
  <head>
    <meta charset="utf-8" />
    <title>Multi Select Combobox</title>
    <script type="module">
      import "@rowan-ui/core/tokens";
      import "@rowan-ui/core/tokens/light";
      import "@rowan-ui/core/multi-select-combobox";
    </script>
  </head>
  <body>
    <rowan-multi-select-combobox
  id="assigned-teams"
  name="team"
  label="Assigned teams"
  placeholder="Search teams"
></rowan-multi-select-combobox>

<script type="module">
  import "@rowan-ui/core/multi-select-combobox";

  const teams = document.querySelector("#assigned-teams");
  teams.options = [
    { value: "design", label: "Design" },
    { value: "engineering", label: "Engineering" },
    { value: "operations", label: "Operations" },
  ];
  teams.selected = ["design", "operations"];

  teams.addEventListener("rowan-change", (event) => {
    console.log(event.detail.selected);
  });
</script>
  </body>
</html>
```

### React

```tsx
import "@rowan-ui/core/tokens";
import "@rowan-ui/core/tokens/light";
import { RowanMultiSelectCombobox } from "@rowan-ui/core/react/multi-select-combobox";

// RowanMultiSelectCombobox maps onRowanChange to the rowan-change event.
export function Example() {
  return (
    <RowanMultiSelectCombobox
      id="assigned-teams"
      name="team"
      label="Assigned teams"
      placeholder="Search teams"
     />
    
    <script type="module">
      import "@rowan-ui/core/multi-select-combobox";
    
      const teams = document.querySelector("#assigned-teams");
      teams.options = [
        { value: "design", label: "Design" },
        { value: "engineering", label: "Engineering" },
        { value: "operations", label: "Operations" },
      ];
      teams.selected = ["design", "operations"];
    
      teams.addEventListener("rowan-change", (event) => {
        console.log(event.detail.selected);
      });
    </script>
  );
}
```

### Excerpt from documentation/app.js (MULTI_SELECT_COMBOBOX_SNIPPET)

```html
<rowan-multi-select-combobox
  id="assigned-teams"
  name="team"
  label="Assigned teams"
  placeholder="Search teams"
></rowan-multi-select-combobox>

<script type="module">
  import "@rowan-ui/core/multi-select-combobox";

  const teams = document.querySelector("#assigned-teams");
  teams.options = [
    { value: "design", label: "Design" },
    { value: "engineering", label: "Engineering" },
    { value: "operations", label: "Operations" },
  ];
  teams.selected = ["design", "operations"];

  teams.addEventListener("rowan-change", (event) => {
    console.log(event.detail.selected);
  });
</script>
```

## rowan-radar-chart

Polar comparison. Categories are axes around the ring. `geometry` is `line` (default) or `area`. Null is no-data and breaks the ring; the host does not treat a gap as zero. Categorical `series`. Nightingale and radial bars are not this host.

- Package: `@rowan-ui/core@0.23.4`
- Import: `@rowan-ui/core/radar-chart`
- React: `RowanRadarChart` from `@rowan-ui/core/react/radar-chart`
- Docs: https://2351labs.github.io/rowan/#radar-chart
- Module: `src/radar-chart/radar-chart.js`

### Attributes

| Name | Type | Default | Reflects | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| brush | boolean | false | yes | Drag, or Shift+Arrow, to select an x range. Escape clears it. |
| description | string |  | yes |  |
| geometry | "line"\|"area" | line | yes | Default `line`. |
| hidden-series | string |  | yes | Space-separated series or slice ids hidden from the plot. |
| interactive | boolean | false | yes |  |
| label | string |  | yes |  |
| large-series | number |  |  | Downsample drawn marks above this count. The data table keeps every row. |
| locale | string |  | yes |  |
| no-motion | boolean | false | yes | Disables chart motion, including under prefers-reduced-motion. |
| sync-group | string |  |  | Share the axis pointer with charts that use the same group name. |

### Properties

| Name | Type | Default | Reflects | Readonly | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| config | RowanRadarChartConfig |  |  |  | Replaces the complete chart configuration. Omitted `geometry` resets to line. |
| description |  |  | yes |  |  |
| externalLabelText |  |  |  | yes | Text of any `<label for>` bound to the host. `label`/`for` cannot cross a shadow boundary. |
| geometry | "line" \| "area" | line | yes |  |  |
| hiddenSeries | string[] |  | yes |  | Ids hidden from the plot. The data table still lists them. |
| interactive |  | false | yes |  |  |
| label |  |  | yes |  |  |
| labels | string[] |  |  | yes | Axis labels around the ring. Arrays are property-only. |
| locale |  |  | yes |  |  |
| messages | RowanRadarChartMessages |  |  |  | Property-only built-in message overrides. |
| noMotion |  |  | yes |  |  |
| series | Array<RowanChartSeries> |  |  |  | Chart series. Arrays are property-only. |
| tooltipFormatter | ((context: { text: string, event: Event, host: HTMLElement }) => string) \| null |  |  |  | Custom tooltip text. Property-only. |
| valueFormatter | RowanChartValueFormatter \| null |  |  |  |  |

### Events

| Name | Detail | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| rowan-brush | startIndex, endIndex, startLabel, endLabel, or cleared. | Selected range. Detail: startIndex, endIndex, startLabel, endLabel, or cleared. |
| rowan-point-activate |  | Fired when a user activates an interactive vertex. |
| rowan-point-click | series, index, datum, value. | Cancelable. Detail: series, index, datum, value. |
| rowan-selection-change |  | Cancelable. Follows rowan-point-click when that event is not canceled. |
| rowan-series-toggle | seriesId, hiddenSeries. | Cancelable. Legend visibility toggle. Detail: seriesId, hiddenSeries. |
| rowan-sync | group, index, label. | Shared hover. Detail: group, index, label. |

### Slots

| Name | Description |
| --- | --- |
| description |  |
| label |  |
| tooltip | Custom tooltip content, used when tooltipFormatter is unset. |

### CSS parts

| Name | Description |
| --- | --- |
| area |  |
| control |  |
| hover |  |
| line |  |
| plot |  |
| point |  |
| table |  |

### CSS properties

| Name | Description |
| --- | --- |
| --rowan-radar-chart-bg |  |

### Methods

None.

### Examples

### HTML

```html
<!doctype html>
<html lang="en">
  <head>
    <meta charset="utf-8" />
    <title>Radar Chart</title>
    <script type="module">
      import "@rowan-ui/core/tokens";
      import "@rowan-ui/core/tokens/light";
      import "@rowan-ui/core/radar-chart";
    </script>
  </head>
  <body>
    <rowan-radar-chart geometry="line" label="Radar Chart"></rowan-radar-chart>
  </body>
</html>
```

### React

```tsx
import "@rowan-ui/core/tokens";
import "@rowan-ui/core/tokens/light";
import { RowanRadarChart } from "@rowan-ui/core/react/radar-chart";

// RowanRadarChart maps onRowanBrush to the rowan-brush event.
export function Example() {
  return (
    <RowanRadarChart geometry="line" label="Radar Chart" />
  );
}
```

## rowan-range-chart

Categorical range. Per-category `{ low, high }`. `variant` is `bar` (default) or `area`. Null low or high is no-data. Own series model — not categorical `series.values`.

- Package: `@rowan-ui/core@0.23.4`
- Import: `@rowan-ui/core/range-chart`
- React: `RowanRangeChart` from `@rowan-ui/core/react/range-chart`
- Docs: https://2351labs.github.io/rowan/#range-chart
- Module: `src/range-chart/range-chart.js`

### Attributes

| Name | Type | Default | Reflects | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| brush | boolean | false | yes | Drag, or Shift+Arrow, to select an x range. Escape clears it. |
| description | string |  | yes |  |
| hidden-series | string |  | yes | Space-separated series or slice ids hidden from the plot. |
| interactive | boolean | false | yes |  |
| label | string |  | yes |  |
| large-series | number |  |  | Downsample drawn marks above this count. The data table keeps every row. |
| locale | string |  | yes |  |
| no-motion | boolean | false | yes | Disables chart motion, including under prefers-reduced-motion. |
| sync-group | string |  |  | Share the axis pointer with charts that use the same group name. |
| variant | "bar"\|"area" | bar | yes | Default `bar`. |
| zoom | boolean | false | yes | Opt-in plot zoom and pan. |

### Properties

| Name | Type | Default | Reflects | Readonly | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| config | RowanRangeChartConfig |  |  |  | Replaces the complete chart configuration. Omitted `variant` resets to bar. |
| description |  |  | yes |  |  |
| externalLabelText |  |  |  | yes | Text of any `<label for>` bound to the host. `label`/`for` cannot cross a shadow boundary. |
| hiddenSeries | string[] |  | yes |  | Ids hidden from the plot. The data table still lists them. |
| interactive |  | false | yes |  |  |
| label |  |  | yes |  |  |
| labels | string[] |  |  | yes | Category labels. Arrays are property-only. |
| locale |  |  | yes |  |  |
| messages | RowanRangeChartMessages |  |  |  | Property-only built-in message overrides. |
| noMotion |  |  | yes |  |  |
| series | Array<object> |  |  |  | Series of `{ id, label, color?, values: [{ low, high }] }`. Arrays are property-only. |
| tooltipFormatter | ((context: { text: string, event: Event, host: HTMLElement }) => string) \| null |  |  |  | Custom tooltip text. Property-only. |
| valueFormatter | RowanRangeChartValueFormatter \| null |  |  |  | Formats table and hover values. Functions are property-only. |
| variant | "bar" \| "area" | bar | yes |  |  |

### Events

| Name | Detail | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| rowan-brush | startIndex, endIndex, startLabel, endLabel, or cleared. | Selected range. Detail: startIndex, endIndex, startLabel, endLabel, or cleared. |
| rowan-point-activate |  | Fired when a user activates an interactive range. Detail includes `low` and `high`. |
| rowan-point-click | series, index, datum, value. | Cancelable. Detail: series, index, datum, value. |
| rowan-selection-change |  | Cancelable. Follows rowan-point-click when that event is not canceled. |
| rowan-series-toggle | seriesId, hiddenSeries. | Cancelable. Legend visibility toggle. Detail: seriesId, hiddenSeries. |
| rowan-sync | group, index, label. | Shared hover. Detail: group, index, label. |
| rowan-zoom | x, y, width, height. | Fired when the zoom window changes. Detail: x, y, width, height. |

### Slots

| Name | Description |
| --- | --- |
| description |  |
| label |  |
| tooltip | Custom tooltip content, used when tooltipFormatter is unset. |

### CSS parts

| Name | Description |
| --- | --- |

| bar |  |
| control |  |
| hover |  |
| plot |  |
| table |  |

### CSS properties

| --- | --- |
| --rowan-range-chart-bg |  |

### Methods

None.

```html
      import "@rowan-ui/core/tokens/light";
      import "@rowan-ui/core/range-chart";
```

## rowan-rich-text-editor

Constrained form-associated authoring control with a property-only document value. The rich mode supports paragraphs, headings (levels 1–3), ordered and unordered lists, plus bold, italic, underline, and allowlisted links. Values are normalized to a safe document object; HTML is never accepted as an API value. Images are not document nodes. Rich clipboard data is inserted as plain text.

- Package: `@rowan-ui/core@0.23.4`
- Import: `@rowan-ui/core/rich-text-editor`
- React: `RowanRichTextEditor` from `@rowan-ui/core/react/rich-text-editor`
- Docs: https://2351labs.github.io/rowan/#rich-text-editor
- Module: `src/rich-text-editor/rich-text-editor.js`

### Attributes

| Name | Type | Default | Reflects | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| description | string |  | yes |  |
| disabled | boolean | false | yes |  |
| invalid | boolean | false | yes |  |
| label | string |  | yes |  |
| mode | "rich"\|"plain" | rich | yes |  |
| name | string |  | yes |  |
| placeholder | string |  | yes |  |
| required | boolean | false | yes |  |

### Properties

| Name | Type | Default | Reflects | Readonly | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| description |  |  | yes |  |  |
| disabled |  | false | yes |  |  |
| externalLabelText |  |  |  | yes | Text of any `<label for>` bound to the host. `label`/`for` cannot cross a shadow boundary. |
| invalid |  | false | yes |  |  |
| label |  |  | yes |  |  |
| messages | RowanRichTextEditorMessages |  |  |  | Property-only built-in message overrides. |
| mode |  | rich | yes |  |  |
| name |  |  | yes |  |  |
| placeholder |  |  | yes |  |  |
| required |  | false | yes |  |  |
| text | string |  |  |  | Plain-text convenience value. Property-only. |
| value | RowanRichTextDocument |  |  |  | Rich document state. Objects are property-only. |

### Events

| Name | Detail | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| rowan-change |  | Fired when a user changes the normalized document. |

### Slots

| Name | Description |
| --- | --- |
| description | Replaces the description attribute. |
| label | Replaces the label attribute. |

### CSS parts

| Name | Description |
| --- | --- |
| control |  |
| description |  |
| editor |  |
| format-button |  |
| label |  |
| plain-text |  |
| toolbar |  |

### CSS properties

| Name | Description |
| --- | --- |
| --rowan-rich-text-editor-bg |  |
| --rowan-rich-text-editor-border |  |
| --rowan-rich-text-editor-toolbar-bg |  |

### Methods

| Name | Description |
| --- | --- |
| clear() |  |
| focus(options) |  |

### Examples

### HTML

```html
<!doctype html>
<html lang="en">
  <head>
    <meta charset="utf-8" />
    <title>Rich Text Editor</title>
    <script type="module">
      import "@rowan-ui/core/tokens";
      import "@rowan-ui/core/tokens/light";
      import "@rowan-ui/core/rich-text-editor";
    </script>
  </head>
  <body>
    <rowan-rich-text-editor
  id="incident-guidance"
  name="incidentGuidance"
  label="Incident guidance"
  placeholder="Describe the response steps"
></rowan-rich-text-editor>

<script type="module">
  import "@rowan-ui/core/rich-text-editor";

  const editor = document.querySelector("#incident-guidance");
  editor.value = {
    blocks: [
      { type: "heading", level: 2, children: [{ text: "Escalation" }] },
      {
        type: "paragraph",
        children: [
          { text: "Escalate to the incident lead.", bold: true },
          { text: " Open the record", href: "/incidents/12" },
        ],
      },
      {
        type: "unordered-list",
        items: [
          [{ text: "Open the incident record" }],
          [{ text: "Notify the on-call team" }],
        ],
      },
    ],
  };

  editor.addEventListener("rowan-change", (event) => {
    console.log(event.detail.value);
  });
</script>
  </body>
</html>
```

### React

```tsx

import "@rowan-ui/core/tokens/light";

// RowanRichTextEditor maps onRowanChange to the rowan-change event.
export function Example() {
  return (
    <RowanRichTextEditor
      id="incident-guidance"
      name="incidentGuidance"
      label="Incident guidance"
      placeholder="Describe the response steps"
     />
    
    <script type="module">
      import "@rowan-ui/core/rich-text-editor";
    
      const editor = document.querySelector("#incident-guidance");
      editor.value = {
        blocks: [
          { type: "heading", level: 2, children: [{ text: "Escalation" }] },
          {
            type: "paragraph",
            children: [
              { text: "Escalate to the incident lead.", bold: true },
              { text: " Open the record", href: "/incidents/12" },
            ],
          },
          {
            type: "unordered-list",
            items: [
              [{ text: "Open the incident record" }],
              [{ text: "Notify the on-call team" }],
            ],
          },
        ],
      };
    
      editor.addEventListener("rowan-change", (event) => {
        console.log(event.detail.value);
      });
    </script>
  );
}
```

## rowan-row-details-panel

Side-panel detail view for a selected Rowan data-table row.

- Package: `@rowan-ui/core@0.23.4`
- Import: `@rowan-ui/core/row-details-panel`
- React: `RowanRowDetailsPanel` from `@rowan-ui/core/react/row-details-panel`
- Docs: https://2351labs.github.io/rowan/#row-details-panel
- Module: `src/row-details-panel/row-details-panel.js`

### Attributes

| Name | Type | Default | Reflects | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| close-label | string | Close details | yes |  |
| for-table | string |  | yes |  |
| label | string | Row details | yes |  |
| locale | string |  | yes |  |
| open | boolean | false | yes |  |
| row-id | string |  | yes |  |
| side | "start"\|"end" | end | yes |  |
| size | "sm"\|"md"\|"lg" | md | yes |  |

### Properties

| Name | Type | Default | Reflects | Readonly | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| closeLabel |  | Close details | yes |  |  |
| externalLabelText |  |  |  | yes | Text of any `<label for>` bound to the host. `label`/`for` cannot cross a shadow boundary. |
| fields |  |  |  |  |  |
| forTable |  |  | yes |  |  |
| label |  | Row details | yes |  |  |
| locale |  |  | yes |  |  |
| messages | RowanRowDetailsPanelMessages |  |  |  | Property-only built-in message overrides. |
| open |  | false | yes |  |  |
| row |  |  |  |  |  |

| rowIds | string[] |  |  |  | Queue of row ids for previous/next. Arrays are property-only. |
| side |  | end | yes |  |  |
| size | "sm" \| "md" \| "lg" | md | yes |  |  |
| table |  |  |  |  |  |

### Events

| Name | Detail | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| rowan-close |  | Fired when the user dismisses the panel |
| rowan-navigate |  | Fired when the user moves to another queued row |

### Slots

| Name | Description |
| --- | --- |
| (default) | Supplemental detail content |
| actions | Panel actions |
| empty | Content shown when no row is available |
| pager | Replaces the default previous/next controls |

### CSS parts

| Name | Description |
| --- | --- |

| body |  |

| empty |  |

| overlay |  |
| pager |  |

| --rowan-row-details-panel-border |  |
| --rowan-row-details-panel-width |  |

### Methods

| Name | Description |
| --- | --- |
| hide() |  |
| refresh() |  |
| show(row, rowId) |  |

### Examples

### HTML

```html
<!doctype html>
<html lang="en">
  <head>
    <meta charset="utf-8" />
    <title>Row Details Panel</title>
    <script type="module">
      import "@rowan-ui/core/tokens";
      import "@rowan-ui/core/tokens/light";
      import "@rowan-ui/core/row-details-panel";
    </script>
  </head>
  <body>
    <rowan-row-details-panel id="member-editor" size="md">
  <rowan-text-field id="member-name" label="Name"></rowan-text-field>
  <div slot="actions">
    <rowan-button id="cancel-edit" variant="secondary">Cancel</rowan-button>
    <rowan-button id="save-edit">Save</rowan-button>
  </div>
</rowan-row-details-panel>

<script type="module">
  let draft = null;
  const panel = document.querySelector("#member-editor");
  const name = document.querySelector("#member-name");

  function beginEdit(row) {
    draft = { ...row };
    name.value = draft.name;
    panel.show(row, row.id);
  }

  name.addEventListener("rowan-change", (event) => {
    draft = { ...draft, name: event.detail.value };
  });

  document.querySelector("#save-edit").addEventListener("rowan-click", async () => {
    await saveMember(draft);
    table.rows = table.rows.map((row) => (row.id === draft.id ? draft : row));
    panel.hide();
  });

  document.querySelector("#cancel-edit").addEventListener("rowan-click", () => panel.hide());
</script>
  </body>
</html>
```

### React

```tsx
import "@rowan-ui/core/tokens";
import "@rowan-ui/core/tokens/light";
import { RowanRowDetailsPanel } from "@rowan-ui/core/react/row-details-panel";

// RowanRowDetailsPanel maps onRowanClose to the rowan-close event.
export function Example() {
  return (
    <RowanRowDetailsPanel id="member-editor" size="md">
      <rowan-text-field id="member-name" label="Name"></rowan-text-field>
      <div slot="actions">
        <rowan-button id="cancel-edit" variant="secondary">Cancel</rowan-button>
        <rowan-button id="save-edit">Save</rowan-button>
      </div>
    </RowanRowDetailsPanel>
    
    <script type="module">
      let draft = null;
      const panel = document.querySelector("#member-editor");
      const name = document.querySelector("#member-name");
    
      function beginEdit(row) {
        draft = { ...row };
        name.value = draft.name;
        panel.show(row, row.id);
      }
    
      name.addEventListener("rowan-change", (event) => {
        draft = { ...draft, name: event.detail.value };
      });
    
      document.querySelector("#save-edit").addEventListener("rowan-click", async () => {
        await saveMember(draft);
        table.rows = table.rows.map((row) => (row.id === draft.id ? draft : row));
        panel.hide();
      });
    
      document.querySelector("#cancel-edit").addEventListener("rowan-click", () => panel.hide());
    </script>
  );
}
```

### Excerpt from documentation/app.js (ROW_DETAILS_PANEL_SNIPPET)

```html
<rowan-table id="members-table"></rowan-table>
<rowan-row-details-panel id="member-details" for-table="members-table" size="md"></rowan-row-details-panel>
<rowan-button id="open-member">View details</rowan-button>

<script type="module">
  const table = document.querySelector("#members-table");
  const panel = document.querySelector("#member-details");

  table.config = {
    selectable: "multiple",
    rowId: "id",
    columns: [
      { id: "name", header: "Name" },
      { id: "role", header: "Role" },
    ],
    rows: [
      { id: "1", name: "Ada", role: "Admin" },
      { id: "2", name: "Alan", role: "Editor" },
    ],
  };

  document.querySelector("#open-member").addEventListener("rowan-click", () => {
    const selected = table.selected;
    const rowId = selected[0] ?? table.rows[0].id;
    const row = table.rows.find((item) => item.id === rowId);
    panel.rowIds = selected.length ? selected : [rowId];
    panel.show(row, rowId);
  });
</script>
```


## rowan-scatter-chart

Scatter / bubble chart. Bubble is a `size` encoding, not a second tag. Null x or y is no-data.

- Package: `@rowan-ui/core@0.23.4`
- Import: `@rowan-ui/core/scatter-chart`
- React: `RowanScatterChart` from `@rowan-ui/core/react/scatter-chart`
- Docs: https://2351labs.github.io/rowan/#scatter-chart
- Module: `src/scatter-chart/scatter-chart.js`

### Attributes

| Name | Type | Default | Reflects | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| brush | boolean | false | yes | Drag, or Shift+Arrow, to select an x range. Escape clears it. |
| description | string |  | yes |  |
| hidden-series | string |  | yes | Space-separated series or slice ids hidden from the plot. |
| interactive | boolean | false | yes |  |
| label | string |  | yes |  |
| large-series | number |  |  | Downsample drawn marks above this count. The data table keeps every row. |
| locale | string |  | yes |  |
| no-motion | boolean | false | yes | Disables chart motion, including under prefers-reduced-motion. |
| sync-group | string |  |  | Share the axis pointer with charts that use the same group name. |
| zoom | boolean | false | yes | Opt-in plot zoom and pan. |

### Properties

| Name | Type | Default | Reflects | Readonly | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| config | RowanScatterChartConfig |  |  |  | Replaces the complete chart configuration. |
| description |  |  | yes |  |  |
| externalLabelText |  |  |  | yes | Text of any `<label for>` bound to the host. `label`/`for` cannot cross a shadow boundary. |
| hiddenSeries | string[] |  | yes |  | Ids hidden from the plot. The data table still lists them. |
| interactive |  | false | yes |  |  |
| label |  |  | yes |  |  |
| locale |  |  | yes |  |  |
| messages | RowanScatterChartMessages |  |  |  | Property-only built-in message overrides. |
| noMotion |  |  | yes |  |  |
| series | Array<object> |  |  |  | Series of `{ id, label, color?, points: [{ x, y, size?, label? }] }`. Arrays are property-only. |
| tooltipFormatter | ((context: { text: string, event: Event, host: HTMLElement }) => string) \| null |  |  |  | Custom tooltip text. Property-only. |
| valueFormatter | RowanScatterChartValueFormatter \| null |  |  |  | Formats table and hover values. Functions are property-only. |

### Events

| Name | Detail | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| rowan-brush | startIndex, endIndex, startLabel, endLabel, or cleared. | Selected range. Detail: startIndex, endIndex, startLabel, endLabel, or cleared. |
| rowan-point-activate |  | Fired when a user activates an interactive point. |
| rowan-point-click | series, index, datum, value. | Cancelable. Detail: series, index, datum, value. |
| rowan-selection-change |  | Cancelable. Follows rowan-point-click when that event is not canceled. |
| rowan-series-toggle | seriesId, hiddenSeries. | Cancelable. Legend visibility toggle. Detail: seriesId, hiddenSeries. |
| rowan-sync | group, index, label. | Shared hover. Detail: group, index, label. |
| rowan-zoom | x, y, width, height. | Fired when the zoom window changes. Detail: x, y, width, height. |

### Slots

| Name | Description |
| --- | --- |
| description |  |
| label |  |
| tooltip | Custom tooltip content, used when tooltipFormatter is unset. |

### CSS parts

| Name | Description |
| --- | --- |
| control |  |
| hover |  |
| plot |  |
| point |  |
| table |  |

### CSS properties

| Name | Description |
| --- | --- |
| --rowan-scatter-chart-bg |  |

### Methods

None.

### Examples

### HTML

```html
<!doctype html>
<html lang="en">
  <head>
    <meta charset="utf-8" />
    <title>Scatter Chart</title>
    <script type="module">
      import "@rowan-ui/core/tokens";
      import "@rowan-ui/core/tokens/light";
      import "@rowan-ui/core/scatter-chart";
    </script>
  </head>
  <body>
    <rowan-scatter-chart label="Scatter Chart"></rowan-scatter-chart>
  </body>
</html>
```

### React

```tsx
import "@rowan-ui/core/tokens";
import "@rowan-ui/core/tokens/light";
import { RowanScatterChart } from "@rowan-ui/core/react/scatter-chart";

// RowanScatterChart maps onRowanBrush to the rowan-brush event.
export function Example() {
  return (
    <RowanScatterChart label="Scatter Chart" />
  );
}
```

## rowan-segmented-control

Compact mutually exclusive mode control.

- Package: `@rowan-ui/core@0.23.4`

### Attributes

| Name | Type | Default | Reflects | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| disabled | boolean | false | yes |  |
| label | string |  | yes |  |
| name | string |  | yes |  |
| required | boolean | false | yes |  |
| size | "sm"\|"md"\|"lg" | md | yes |  |
| value | string |  | yes |  |

### Properties

| Name | Type | Default | Reflects | Readonly | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| disabled |  | false | yes |  |  |
| externalLabelText |  |  |  | yes | Text of any `<label for>` bound to the host. `label`/`for` cannot cross a shadow boundary. |
| label |  |  | yes |  |  |
| name |  |  | yes |  |  |
| options | Array<string \| { value: string, label?: string, disabled?: boolean }> |  |  |  | Available modes. Arrays are property-only. |
| required |  | false | yes |  |  |
| selectedOption |  |  |  | yes |  |
| size | "sm" \| "md" \| "lg" | md | yes |  |  |
| value |  |  | yes |  |  |

### Events

| Name | Detail | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| rowan-change |  | Fired when a user chooses a different mode |

### Slots

None.

### CSS parts

| Name | Description |
| --- | --- |
| button |  |
| control |  |
| label |  |

### CSS properties

| Name | Description |
| --- | --- |
| --rowan-segmented-control-active-bg |  |
| --rowan-segmented-control-bg |  |

### Methods

None.

### Examples

### HTML

```html
<!doctype html>
<html lang="en">
  <head>
    <meta charset="utf-8" />
    <title>Segmented Control</title>
    <script type="module">
      import "@rowan-ui/core/tokens";
      import "@rowan-ui/core/tokens/light";
      import "@rowan-ui/core/segmented-control";
    </script>
  </head>
  <body>
    <rowan-segmented-control id="view-mode" name="view" label="View mode"></rowan-segmented-control>

<script type="module">
  import "@rowan-ui/core/segmented-control";

  const viewMode = document.querySelector("#view-mode");
  viewMode.options = [
    { value: "board", label: "Board" },
    { value: "list", label: "List" },
    { value: "timeline", label: "Timeline" },
  ];
  viewMode.value = "board";

  viewMode.addEventListener("rowan-change", (event) => {
    console.log(event.detail.value);
  });
</script>
  </body>
</html>
```

### React

```tsx
import "@rowan-ui/core/tokens";
import "@rowan-ui/core/tokens/light";
import { RowanSegmentedControl } from "@rowan-ui/core/react/segmented-control";

// RowanSegmentedControl maps onRowanChange to the rowan-change event.
export function Example() {
  return (
    <RowanSegmentedControl id="view-mode" name="view" label="View mode" />
    
    <script type="module">
      import "@rowan-ui/core/segmented-control";
    
      const viewMode = document.querySelector("#view-mode");
      viewMode.options = [
        { value: "board", label: "Board" },
        { value: "list", label: "List" },
        { value: "timeline", label: "Timeline" },
      ];
      viewMode.value = "board";
    
      viewMode.addEventListener("rowan-change", (event) => {
        console.log(event.detail.value);
      });
    </script>
  );
}
```

### Excerpt from documentation/app.js (SEGMENTED_CONTROL_SNIPPET)

```html
<rowan-segmented-control id="view-mode" name="view" label="View mode"></rowan-segmented-control>

  const viewMode = document.querySelector("#view-mode");

    { value: "timeline", label: "Timeline" },
  ];
  viewMode.value = "board";

  viewMode.addEventListener("rowan-change", (event) => {
    console.log(event.detail.value);
  });
</script>
```

## rowan-side-nav

Application navigation controller for rowan-side-nav-item children.

- Package: `@rowan-ui/core@0.23.4`
- Import: `@rowan-ui/core/side-nav`
- React: `RowanSideNav` from `@rowan-ui/core/react/side-nav`
- Docs: https://2351labs.github.io/rowan/#side-nav
- Module: `src/side-nav/side-nav.js`

### Attributes

| Name | Type | Default | Reflects | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| label | string |  | yes |  |
| value | string |  | yes |  |

### Properties

| Name | Type | Default | Reflects | Readonly | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| activeItem | RowanSideNavItem \| null |  |  | yes |  |
| externalLabelText |  |  |  | yes | Text of any `<label for>` bound to the host. `label`/`for` cannot cross a shadow boundary. |
| label |  |  | yes |  |  |
| value |  |  | yes |  |  |

### Events

| Name | Detail | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| rowan-change |  | Fired when a user activates a different navigation item. Cancelable when the item has an in-app href; preventDefault to block navigation. |

### Slots

| Name | Description |
| --- | --- |
| (default) | rowan-side-nav-item and optional rowan-side-nav-section nodes |

### CSS parts

| Name | Description |
| --- | --- |
| nav |  |

### CSS properties

| Name | Description |
| --- | --- |
| --rowan-side-nav-gap |  |

### Methods

None.

### Examples

### HTML

```html
<!doctype html>
<html lang="en">
  <head>
    <meta charset="utf-8" />
    <title>Side Nav</title>
    <script type="module">
      import "@rowan-ui/core/tokens";
      import "@rowan-ui/core/tokens/light";
      import "@rowan-ui/core/side-nav";
    </script>
  </head>
  <body>
    <rowan-side-nav id="project-nav" label="Project navigation" value="overview">
  <rowan-side-nav-section label="Workspace">
    <rowan-side-nav-item value="overview">Overview</rowan-side-nav-item>
    <rowan-side-nav-item value="activity">Activity</rowan-side-nav-item>
  </rowan-side-nav-section>
</rowan-side-nav>

<script type="module">
  import "@rowan-ui/core/side-nav";
  import "@rowan-ui/core/side-nav-section";

  const nav = document.querySelector("#project-nav");
  nav.addEventListener("rowan-change", (event) => {
    event.preventDefault();
    router.push(event.detail.value);
  });
</script>
  </body>
</html>
```

### React

```tsx
import "@rowan-ui/core/tokens";
import "@rowan-ui/core/tokens/light";
import { RowanSideNav } from "@rowan-ui/core/react/side-nav";

// RowanSideNav maps onRowanChange to the rowan-change event.
export function Example() {
  return (
    <RowanSideNav id="project-nav" label="Project navigation" value="overview">
      <RowanSideNav-section label="Workspace">
        <RowanSideNav-item value="overview">Overview</rowan-side-nav-item>
        <RowanSideNav-item value="activity">Activity</rowan-side-nav-item>
      </rowan-side-nav-section>
    </RowanSideNav>
    
    <script type="module">
      import "@rowan-ui/core/side-nav";
      import "@rowan-ui/core/side-nav-section";
    
      const nav = document.querySelector("#project-nav");
      nav.addEventListener("rowan-change", (event) => {
        event.preventDefault();
        router.push(event.detail.value);
      });
    </script>
  );
}
```

### Excerpt from documentation/app.js (SIDE_NAV_SNIPPET)

## rowan-side-nav-section

Labeled group of destinations inside rowan-side-nav. Opt-in `collapsible` adds a disclosure control. `collapsed` defaults false (open). The parent nav still has one `value`; this host is not a destination.

- Package: `@rowan-ui/core@0.23.4`
- Import: `@rowan-ui/core/side-nav-section`
- React: `RowanSideNavSection` from `@rowan-ui/core/react/side-nav-section`
- Docs: https://2351labs.github.io/rowan/#side-nav-section
- Module: `src/side-nav-section/side-nav-section.js`

| collapsed | boolean | false | yes |  |
| collapsible | boolean | false | yes |  |
| label | string |  | yes |  |

| Name | Type | Default | Reflects | Readonly | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| collapsed |  | false | yes |  |  |
| collapsible |  | false | yes |  |  |
| expanded | boolean |  |  | yes |  |
| externalLabelText |  |  |  | yes | Text of any `<label for>` bound to the host. `label`/`for` cannot cross a shadow boundary. |
| label |  |  | yes |  |  |

### Events

| Name | Detail | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| rowan-toggle |  | Fired when a user expands or collapses a collapsible section |

### Slots

| --- | --- |

| --rowan-side-nav-section-label-fg |  |
| --rowan-side-nav-section-label-font-size |  |

| Name | Description |

```html
      import "@rowan-ui/core/side-nav-section";

    event.preventDefault();
    router.push(event.detail.value);

  </body>
```

## rowan-skeleton

Loading placeholder block.

- Package: `@rowan-ui/core@0.23.4`
- Import: `@rowan-ui/core/skeleton`
- React: `RowanSkeleton` from `@rowan-ui/core/react/skeleton`
- Docs: https://2351labs.github.io/rowan/#skeleton
- Module: `src/skeleton/skeleton.js`

### Attributes

| Name | Type | Default | Reflects | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| animated | boolean | false | yes |  |
| height | string |  | yes |  |
| shape | "text"\|"rect"\|"circle" | text | yes |  |
| width | string |  | yes |  |

### Properties

| Name | Type | Default | Reflects | Readonly | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| animated |  | false | yes |  |  |
| externalLabelText |  |  |  | yes | Text of any `<label for>` bound to the host. `label`/`for` cannot cross a shadow boundary. |
| height |  |  | yes |  |  |
| shape | "text" \| "rect" \| "circle" | text | yes |  |  |
| width |  |  | yes |  |  |

### Events

### Slots

| Name | Description |
| --- | --- |

| --rowan-skeleton-highlight |  |
| --rowan-skeleton-shimmer-duration |  |

### Methods

None.

### Examples

### HTML

```html
<!doctype html>
<html lang="en">
  <head>
    <meta charset="utf-8" />
    <title>Skeleton</title>
    <script type="module">
      import "@rowan-ui/core/tokens";
      import "@rowan-ui/core/tokens/light";
      import "@rowan-ui/core/skeleton";
    </script>
  </head>
  <body>
    <rowan-skeleton shape="circle" width="2.5rem" height="2.5rem" animated></rowan-skeleton>
<rowan-skeleton shape="text" width="14rem" animated></rowan-skeleton>
<rowan-skeleton shape="rect" width="100%" height="4.5rem" animated></rowan-skeleton>
  </body>
</html>
```

### React

```tsx
import "@rowan-ui/core/tokens";
import "@rowan-ui/core/tokens/light";
import { RowanSkeleton } from "@rowan-ui/core/react/skeleton";

export function Example() {
  return (
    <RowanSkeleton shape="circle" width="2.5rem" height="2.5rem" animated />
    <RowanSkeleton shape="text" width="14rem" animated />
    <RowanSkeleton shape="rect" width="100%" height="4.5rem" animated />
  );
}
```

```html
        <rowan-skeleton shape="text" width="14rem" animated></rowan-skeleton>
        <rowan-skeleton shape="text" width="10rem" animated></rowan-skeleton>
        <rowan-skeleton shape="rect" width="100%" height="4.5rem" animated></rowan-skeleton>
      </div>
```

## rowan-slider

Numeric slider with single-value and ordered range modes.

- Package: `@rowan-ui/core@0.23.4`
- Import: `@rowan-ui/core/slider`
- React: `RowanSlider` from `@rowan-ui/core/react/slider`
- Docs: https://2351labs.github.io/rowan/#slider
- Module: `src/slider/slider.js`

### Attributes

| Name | Type | Default | Reflects | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| disabled | boolean | false | yes |  |
| end | number |  | yes |  |
| invalid | boolean | false | yes |  |
| label | string |  | yes |  |
| locale | string |  | yes |  |
| max | number | 100 | yes |  |
| min | number | 0 | yes |  |
| name | string |  | yes |  |
| name-end | string |  | yes |  |
| name-start | string |  | yes |  |
| range | boolean | false | yes |  |
| required | boolean | false | yes |  |
| start | number |  | yes |  |
| step | number | 1 | yes |  |
| value | number |  | yes |  |

### Properties

| Name | Type | Default | Reflects | Readonly | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| disabled |  | false | yes |  |  |
| end |  |  | yes |  |  |
| externalLabelText |  |  |  | yes | Text of any `<label for>` bound to the host. `label`/`for` cannot cross a shadow boundary. |
| formatValue |  |  |  |  |  |
| invalid |  | false | yes |  |  |
| label |  |  | yes |  |  |
| locale |  |  | yes |  |  |
| max |  | 100 | yes |  |  |
| messages | RowanSliderMessages |  |  |  | Property-only built-in message overrides. |
| min |  | 0 | yes |  |  |
| name |  |  | yes |  |  |
| nameEnd |  |  | yes |  |  |
| nameStart |  |  | yes |  |  |
| range |  | false | yes |  |  |
| required |  | false | yes |  |  |
| start |  |  | yes |  |  |
| step |  | 1 | yes |  |  |
| value |  |  | yes |  |  |

### Events

| Name | Detail | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| rowan-change |  | Fired when a user changes a slider value |

### Slots

None.

### CSS parts

| Name | Description |
| --- | --- |
| end-input |  |
| input |  |
| range |  |
| slider |  |
| start-input |  |
| track |  |
| value |  |

### CSS properties

| Name | Description |
| --- | --- |
| --rowan-slider-range-bg |  |
| --rowan-slider-thumb-bg |  |
| --rowan-slider-track-bg |  |

### Methods

None.

### Examples

### HTML

```html
<!doctype html>
<html lang="en">
  <head>
    <meta charset="utf-8" />
    <title>Slider</title>
    <script type="module">
      import "@rowan-ui/core/tokens";
      import "@rowan-ui/core/tokens/light";
      import "@rowan-ui/core/slider";
    </script>
  </head>
  <body>
    <rowan-slider name="capacity" min="0" max="100" step="5"></rowan-slider>

<script type="module">
  const slider = document.querySelector("rowan-slider");
  slider.value = 65;
  slider.formatValue = (value) => String(value) + "% capacity";
</script>
  </body>
</html>
```

### React

```tsx
import "@rowan-ui/core/tokens";
import "@rowan-ui/core/tokens/light";
import { RowanSlider } from "@rowan-ui/core/react/slider";

// RowanSlider maps onRowanChange to the rowan-change event.
export function Example() {
  return (
    <RowanSlider name="capacity" min="0" max="100" step="5" />
    
    <script type="module">
      const slider = document.querySelector("rowan-slider");
      slider.value = 65;
      slider.formatValue = (value) => String(value) + "% capacity";
    </script>
  );
}
```

### Excerpt from documentation/app.js (RANGE_SLIDER_SNIPPET)

```html
<rowan-slider name="budget" range min="0" max="500" step="25"></rowan-slider>

<script type="module">
  const slider = document.querySelector("rowan-slider");
  slider.value = { start: 100, end: 300 };
  slider.formatValue = ({ start, end }) => "$" + start + " - $" + end;
</script>
```

### Excerpt from documentation/app.js (SLIDER_SNIPPET)

```html
<rowan-slider name="capacity" min="0" max="100" step="5"></rowan-slider>

<script type="module">
  const slider = document.querySelector("rowan-slider");
  slider.value = 65;
  slider.formatValue = (value) => String(value) + "% capacity";
</script>
```


## rowan-source-meta

Provenance line for KPI description, chart description, or table caption. Does not add fields to those frozen hosts.

- Package: `@rowan-ui/core@0.23.4`
- Import: `@rowan-ui/core/source-meta`
- React: `RowanSourceMeta` from `@rowan-ui/core/react/source-meta`
- Docs: https://2351labs.github.io/rowan/#source-meta
- Module: `src/source-meta/source-meta.js`

### Attributes

| Name | Type | Default | Reflects | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| as-of | string |  | yes |  |
| source | string |  | yes |  |

### Properties

| Name | Type | Default | Reflects | Readonly | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| asOf |  |  | yes |  |  |
| externalLabelText |  |  |  | yes | Text of any `<label for>` bound to the host. `label`/`for` cannot cross a shadow boundary. |
| messages | RowanSourceMetaMessages |  |  |  | Property-only built-in message overrides. |
| source |  |  | yes |  |  |

### Events

None.

### Slots

| --- | --- |

```html
      import "@rowan-ui/core/source-meta";
    </script>
```

## rowan-sparkline

Frozen compact one-series line for KPI tiles. Not a density of `rowan-trend-chart`. Additive `variant="area"` fills to the baseline (or to `target` when set).

- Package: `@rowan-ui/core@0.23.4`
- Import: `@rowan-ui/core/sparkline`
- React: `RowanSparkline` from `@rowan-ui/core/react/sparkline`
- Docs: https://2351labs.github.io/rowan/#sparkline
- Module: `src/sparkline/sparkline.js`

### Attributes

| Name | Type | Default | Reflects | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| above-tone | "neutral"\|"info"\|"success"\|"warning"\|"danger" | warning | yes | Stroke above target. Used when `target` is set. |
| below-tone | "neutral"\|"info"\|"success"\|"warning"\|"danger" | success | yes | Stroke at or below target. Used when `target` is set. |
| hidden-series | string |  | yes | Space-separated series or slice ids hidden from the plot. |
| label | string |  | yes |  |
| locale | string |  | yes |  |
| no-motion | boolean | false | yes | Disables chart motion, including under prefers-reduced-motion. |
| tone | "neutral"\|"info"\|"success"\|"warning"\|"danger" | neutral | yes |  |
| variant | "line"\|"area" | neutral | yes | `area` fills under the stroke. Default `line`. |

### Properties

| Name | Type | Default | Reflects | Readonly | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| aboveTone | "neutral" \| "info" \| "success" \| "warning" \| "danger" | warning | yes |  |  |
| belowTone | "neutral" \| "info" \| "success" \| "warning" \| "danger" | success | yes |  |  |
| externalLabelText |  |  |  | yes | Text of any `<label for>` bound to the host. `label`/`for` cannot cross a shadow boundary. |
| hiddenSeries | string[] |  | yes |  | `series` hides the line. `target` hides the target. The data table still lists them. |
| label |  |  | yes |  |  |
| labels | string[] |  |  | yes | Optional point labels for the accessible table. Arrays are property-only. |
| locale |  |  | yes |  |  |
| messages | RowanSparklineMessages |  |  |  | Property-only built-in message overrides. |
| noMotion |  |  | yes |  |  |
| target | number \| null |  |  |  | Target value. Property-only. Null hides the split and the dashed line. |
| tone | "neutral" \| "info" \| "success" \| "warning" \| "danger" | neutral | yes |  |  |
| tooltipFormatter | ((context: { text: string, event: Event, host: HTMLElement }) => string) \| null |  |  |  | Custom tooltip text. Property-only. |
| values | Array<number \| null> |  |  |  | One series. Arrays are property-only. Null is a gap. |
| variant | "line" \| "area" | neutral | yes |  |  |

### Events

| Name | Detail | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| rowan-point-activate | index, label, value. | Keyboard activation. Detail: index, label, value. |
| rowan-point-click | series, index, datum, value. | Cancelable. Detail: series, index, datum, value. |
| rowan-selection-change |  | Cancelable. Follows rowan-point-click when that event is not canceled. |
| rowan-series-toggle | seriesId, hiddenSeries. | Cancelable. Legend visibility toggle. Detail: seriesId, hiddenSeries. |

### Slots

| Name | Description |
| --- | --- |
| tooltip | Custom tooltip content, used when tooltipFormatter is unset. |

### CSS parts

| Name | Description |
| --- | --- |
| area |  |
| chart |  |
| hover |  |
| hover-point |  |
| line |  |
| plot |  |
| table |  |
| target |  |

### CSS properties

| Name | Description |
| --- | --- |
| --rowan-sparkline-danger |  |
| --rowan-sparkline-fill-opacity |  |
| --rowan-sparkline-height |  |
| --rowan-sparkline-hover-size |  |
| --rowan-sparkline-info |  |
| --rowan-sparkline-stroke |  |
| --rowan-sparkline-stroke-width |  |
| --rowan-sparkline-success |  |
| --rowan-sparkline-target |  |
| --rowan-sparkline-target-width |  |
| --rowan-sparkline-warning |  |

### Methods

None.

### Examples

### HTML

```html
<!doctype html>
<html lang="en">
  <head>
    <meta charset="utf-8" />
    <title>Sparkline</title>
    <script type="module">
      import "@rowan-ui/core/tokens";
      import "@rowan-ui/core/tokens/light";
      import "@rowan-ui/core/sparkline";
    </script>
  </head>
  <body>
    <rowan-kpi-card label="Open incidents" tone="warning" delta-label="vs last week">
  <rowan-sparkline slot="chart" label="Open incidents this week"></rowan-sparkline>
</rowan-kpi-card>

<script type="module">
  import "@rowan-ui/core/kpi-card";
  import "@rowan-ui/core/sparkline";

  const card = document.querySelector("rowan-kpi-card");
  const chart = document.querySelector("rowan-sparkline");
  card.value = 11;
  card.delta = -7;
  chart.values = [18, 24, 12, 15, 9, 11];
</script>
  </body>
</html>
```

### React

```tsx
import "@rowan-ui/core/tokens";
import "@rowan-ui/core/tokens/light";
import { RowanSparkline } from "@rowan-ui/core/react/sparkline";

// RowanSparkline maps onRowanPointActivate to the rowan-point-activate event.
export function Example() {
  return (
    <rowan-kpi-card label="Open incidents" tone="warning" delta-label="vs last week">
      <RowanSparkline slot="chart" label="Open incidents this week" />
    </rowan-kpi-card>
    
    <script type="module">
      import "@rowan-ui/core/kpi-card";
      import "@rowan-ui/core/sparkline";
    
      const card = document.querySelector("rowan-kpi-card");
      const chart = document.querySelector("rowan-sparkline");
      card.value = 11;
      card.delta = -7;
      chart.values = [18, 24, 12, 15, 9, 11];
    </script>
  );
}
```

### Excerpt from documentation/app.js (SPARKLINE_SNIPPET)

```html
<rowan-kpi-card label="Open incidents" tone="warning" delta-label="vs last week">
  <rowan-sparkline slot="chart" label="Open incidents this week"></rowan-sparkline>
</rowan-kpi-card>

<script type="module">
  import "@rowan-ui/core/kpi-card";
  import "@rowan-ui/core/sparkline";

  const card = document.querySelector("rowan-kpi-card");
  const chart = document.querySelector("rowan-sparkline");
  card.value = 11;
  card.delta = -7;
  chart.values = [18, 24, 12, 15, 9, 11];
</script>
```
