## rowan-split-pane

Resizable two-pane workspace layout.

- Package: `@rowan-ui/core@0.23.4`
- Import: `@rowan-ui/core/split-pane`
- React: `RowanSplitPane` from `@rowan-ui/core/react/split-pane`
- Docs: https://2351labs.github.io/rowan/#split-pane
- Module: `src/split-pane/split-pane.js`

### Attributes

| Name | Type | Default | Reflects | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| disabled | boolean | false | yes |  |
| locale | string |  | yes |  |
| max | number | 100 | yes |  |
| min | number | 0 | yes |  |
| orientation | "horizontal"\|"vertical" | horizontal | yes |  |
| position | number |  | yes |  |
| snap-threshold | number |  | yes |  |
| step | number |  | yes |  |

### Properties

| Name | Type | Default | Reflects | Readonly | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| disabled |  | false | yes |  |  |
| externalLabelText |  |  |  | yes | Text of any `<label for>` bound to the host. `label`/`for` cannot cross a shadow boundary. |
| locale |  |  | yes |  |  |
| max | number | 100 | yes |  |  |
| messages | RowanSplitPaneMessages |  |  |  | Property-only built-in message overrides. |
| min | number | 0 | yes |  |  |
| orientation |  | horizontal | yes |  |  |
| position | number |  | yes |  |  |
| snapPoints | number[] |  |  |  | Property-only percentage positions that attract nearby resize values. |
| snapThreshold | number |  | yes |  |  |
| step | number |  | yes |  |  |

### Events

| Name | Detail | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| rowan-resize |  | Fired when a user resizes the pane with the separator. |

### Slots

| Name | Description |
| --- | --- |
| end | End pane content. |
| start | Start pane content. |

### CSS parts

| Name | Description |
| --- | --- |
| end |  |
| layout |  |
| separator |  |
| start |  |

### CSS properties

| Name | Description |
| --- | --- |
| --rowan-split-pane-gap |  |
| --rowan-split-pane-separator-color |  |
| --rowan-split-pane-separator-size |  |

### Methods

None.

### Examples

### HTML

```html
<!doctype html>
<html lang="en">
  <head>
    <meta charset="utf-8" />
    <title>Split Pane</title>
    <script type="module">
      import "@rowan-ui/core/tokens";
      import "@rowan-ui/core/tokens/light";
      import "@rowan-ui/core/split-pane";
    </script>
  </head>
  <body>
    <rowan-split-pane id="workspace-pane" position="32" min="20" max="80">
  <aside slot="start">Navigation</aside>
  <main slot="end">Workspace content</main>
</rowan-split-pane>

<script type="module">
  import "@rowan-ui/core/split-pane";

  const pane = document.querySelector("#workspace-pane");
  pane.snapPoints = [25, 50, 75];

  pane.addEventListener("rowan-resize", (event) => {
    console.log(event.detail.value);
  });
</script>
  </body>
</html>
```

### React

```tsx
import "@rowan-ui/core/tokens";
import "@rowan-ui/core/tokens/light";
import { RowanSplitPane } from "@rowan-ui/core/react/split-pane";

// RowanSplitPane maps onRowanResize to the rowan-resize event.
export function Example() {
  return (
    <RowanSplitPane id="workspace-pane" position="32" min="20" max="80">
      <aside slot="start">Navigation</aside>
      <main slot="end">Workspace content</main>
    </RowanSplitPane>
    
    <script type="module">
      import "@rowan-ui/core/split-pane";
    
      const pane = document.querySelector("#workspace-pane");
      pane.snapPoints = [25, 50, 75];
    
      pane.addEventListener("rowan-resize", (event) => {
        console.log(event.detail.value);
      });
    </script>
  );
}
```

### Excerpt from documentation/app.js (SPLIT_PANE_SNIPPET)

```html
<rowan-split-pane id="workspace-pane" position="32" min="20" max="80">
  <aside slot="start">Navigation</aside>
  <main slot="end">Workspace content</main>
</rowan-split-pane>

<script type="module">
  import "@rowan-ui/core/split-pane";

  const pane = document.querySelector("#workspace-pane");
  pane.snapPoints = [25, 50, 75];

  pane.addEventListener("rowan-resize", (event) => {
    console.log(event.detail.value);
  });
</script>
```


## rowan-stacked-area-chart

Stacked categorical area chart. Positive values stack from zero. Null and negatives are no-data.

- Package: `@rowan-ui/core@0.23.4`
- Import: `@rowan-ui/core/stacked-area-chart`
- React: `RowanStackedAreaChart` from `@rowan-ui/core/react/stacked-area-chart`
- Docs: https://2351labs.github.io/rowan/#stacked-area-chart
- Module: `src/stacked-area-chart/stacked-area-chart.js`

### Attributes

| Name | Type | Default | Reflects | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| brush | boolean | false | yes | Drag, or Shift+Arrow, to select an x range. Escape clears it. |
| description | string |  | yes |  |
| hidden-series | string |  | yes | Space-separated series or slice ids hidden from the plot. |
| interactive | boolean | false | yes |  |
| label | string |  | yes |  |
| large-series | number |  |  | Downsample drawn marks above this count. The data table keeps every row. |
| locale | string |  | yes |  |
| no-motion | boolean | false | yes | Disables chart motion, including under prefers-reduced-motion. |
| stack-mode | "absolute"\|"normalized" | absolute | yes | `normalized` scales each category to 100. Default `absolute`. |
| sync-group | string |  |  | Share the axis pointer with charts that use the same group name. |
| zoom | boolean | false | yes | Opt-in plot zoom and pan. |

### Properties

| Name | Type | Default | Reflects | Readonly | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| config | RowanStackedAreaChartConfig |  |  |  | Replaces the complete chart configuration. Omitted `stackMode` resets to absolute. |
| description |  |  | yes |  |  |
| externalLabelText |  |  |  | yes | Text of any `<label for>` bound to the host. `label`/`for` cannot cross a shadow boundary. |
| hiddenSeries | string[] |  | yes |  | Ids hidden from the plot. The data table still lists them. |
| interactive |  | false | yes |  |  |
| label |  |  | yes |  |  |
| labels | string[] |  |  | yes | Category labels. Arrays are property-only. |
| locale |  |  | yes |  |  |
| messages | RowanStackedAreaChartMessages |  |  |  | Property-only built-in message overrides. |
| noMotion |  |  | yes |  |  |
| referenceLines | RowanChartReferenceLine[] |  |  |  | Horizontal overlays. Arrays are property-only. Normalized mode uses a 0–100 scale. |
| series | Array<RowanChartSeries> |  |  |  | Chart series. Arrays are property-only. |
| stackMode | "absolute" \| "normalized" | absolute | yes |  |  |
| tooltipFormatter | ((context: { text: string, event: Event, host: HTMLElement }) => string) \| null |  |  |  | Custom tooltip text. Property-only. |
| valueFormatter | RowanChartValueFormatter \| null |  |  |  | Formats chart and table values. Functions are property-only. |

### Events

| Name | Detail | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| rowan-brush | startIndex, endIndex, startLabel, endLabel, or cleared. | Selected range. Detail: startIndex, endIndex, startLabel, endLabel, or cleared. |
| rowan-point-activate |  | Fired when a user activates an interactive point. |
| rowan-point-click | series, index, datum, value. | Cancelable. Detail: series, index, datum, value. |
| rowan-selection-change |  | Cancelable. Follows rowan-point-click when that event is not canceled. |
| rowan-series-toggle | seriesId, hiddenSeries. | Cancelable. Legend visibility toggle. Detail: seriesId, hiddenSeries. |
| rowan-sync | group, index, label. | Shared hover. Detail: group, index, label. |
| rowan-zoom | x, y, width, height. | Fired when the zoom window changes. Detail: x, y, width, height. |

### Slots

| Name | Description |
| --- | --- |
| description |  |
| label |  |
| tooltip | Custom tooltip content, used when tooltipFormatter is unset. |

### CSS parts

| Name | Description |
| --- | --- |
| area |  |
| chart |  |
| control |  |
| description |  |
| detail |  |
| hover |  |
| label |  |
| legend |  |
| line |  |
| plot |  |
| reference-line |  |
| summary |  |
| table |  |

### CSS properties

| Name | Description |
| --- | --- |
| --rowan-stacked-area-chart-bg |  |

### Methods

None.

### Examples

### HTML

```html
<!doctype html>
<html lang="en">
  <head>
    <meta charset="utf-8" />
    <title>Stacked Area Chart</title>
    <script type="module">
      import "@rowan-ui/core/tokens";
      import "@rowan-ui/core/tokens/light";
      import "@rowan-ui/core/stacked-area-chart";
    </script>
  </head>
  <body>
    <rowan-stacked-area-chart label="Stacked Area Chart" stack-mode="absolute"></rowan-stacked-area-chart>
  </body>
</html>
```

### React

```tsx
import "@rowan-ui/core/tokens";
import "@rowan-ui/core/tokens/light";
import { RowanStackedAreaChart } from "@rowan-ui/core/react/stacked-area-chart";

// RowanStackedAreaChart maps onRowanBrush to the rowan-brush event.
export function Example() {
  return (
    <RowanStackedAreaChart label="Stacked Area Chart" stack-mode="absolute" />
  );
}
```

```html
    <rowan-tab-panel value="overview">
  <p>North yard is receiving until 18:00. Fill rate is 82%.</p>
</rowan-tab-panel>
  </body>
</html>
```

## rowan-table

Config-driven data table.

- Package: `@rowan-ui/core@0.23.4`
- Import: `@rowan-ui/core/table`
- React: `RowanTable` from `@rowan-ui/core/react/table`
- Docs: https://2351labs.github.io/rowan/#table
- Module: `src/table/table.js`

### Attributes

| Name | Type | Default | Reflects | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| caption | string |  | yes |  |
| caption-visually-hidden | boolean | false | yes |  |
| data-mode | "client"\|"server" |  | yes | `client` pages, sorts, and groups local rows. `server` asks `dataSource.getRows` instead. Default `client`. |
| density | "sm"\|"md"\|"lg" | md | yes |  |
| edit-mode | "cell"\|"row" |  | yes | `cell` edits one cell. `row` edits every editable cell in the row. |
| loading | boolean | false | yes |  |
| locale | string |  | yes |  |
| reorderable-columns | boolean | false | yes |  |
| resizable-columns | boolean | false | yes |  |
| selectable | "none"\|"single"\|"multiple" | none | yes |  |
| sort | string |  | yes | JSON sort model. One `{"id","dir"}` object or an ordered array of those objects. |
| sticky-header | boolean | false | yes |  |
| virtual-item-size | number |  | yes |  |
| virtual-overscan | number |  | yes |  |
| virtualized | boolean | false | yes |  |

### Properties

| Name | Type | Default | Reflects | Readonly | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| caption |  |  | yes |  |  |
| captionVisuallyHidden |  | false | yes |  |  |
| columns | Array<object> |  |  |  | Updates columns without replacing other configuration. |
| config | object |  |  |  | Replaces the complete table configuration. |
| dataMode |  |  | yes |  |  |
| dataSource | object \| null |  |  |  | Server reads. `getRows({ page, pageSize, sort, filters, signal })` returns `{ rows, total }`. `sort` is an ordered array of `{ id, dir }`, or null. Optional `getChildren({ parentId, parent, sort, filters, signal })` returns `{ rows }` for one expanded parent and receives that same ordered `sort`. Optional `debounce` replaces the 200ms filter delay. Ignored when `data-mode` is `client`. |
| density | RowanTableDensity | md | yes |  |  |
| editMode |  |  | yes |  |  |
| externalLabelText |  |  |  | yes | Text of any `<label for>` bound to the host. `label`/`for` cannot cross a shadow boundary. |
| filters | Array<object> |  |  |  | Sent to `dataSource.getRows`. Quick filters are `{ id, value }`. A `rowan-filter-builder` tree (`{ field, operator, value }` leaves and `{ join, filters }` groups) is passed through intact. Assigning filters resets to the first page and is debounced. Client mode does not apply them unless `tree` is set, where `{ id, value }` filters keep ancestors of matches. The filter builder still evaluates its own tree. A column menu filter updates this list and fires `rowan-column-filter`. |
| groupBy | RowanTableGroupBy \| null |  |  |  |  |
| itemKey | string |  |  |  |  |
| loading |  | false | yes |  |  |
| locale |  |  | yes |  |  |
| messages | RowanTableMessages |  |  |  | Property-only built-in message overrides. |
| page | RowanTablePage \| null |  |  |  |  |
| reorderableColumns |  | false | yes |  |  |
| resizableColumns |  | false | yes |  |  |
| rowActivate | "dblclick" \| "none" |  |  |  |  |
| rows | Array<object> |  |  |  | Updates rows without replacing other configuration. |
| selectable | RowanTableSelectable | none | yes |  |  |
| selected | Array<string> |  |  |  | Updates selected row IDs without replacing other configuration. |
| selectedRows | RowanTableRow[] |  |  | yes |  |
| sort | RowanTableSort \| RowanTableSort[] \| null |  | yes |  |  |
| stickyHeader |  | false | yes |  |  |
| tree | object \| null |  |  |  | Hierarchical rows. Use `childrenField` (default `"children"`), `getChildren(row)`, or `parentField` for a flat parent id. `hasChildren(row)` marks a server row that can load children. `expanded` is the initial open row ids. `defaultExpanded` opens every loaded parent. `groupBy` is ignored while a tree is set. Pagination slices root rows; expanded children stay with their parent. Sibling sort follows the ordered `sort` array. Column menu actions apply to these columns. |
| virtualItemSize | number |  | yes |  | Estimated row height used before a row is measured. |
| virtualized | boolean | false | yes |  | Renders a measured, bounded row window inside the table viewport. |
| virtualOverscan | number |  | yes |  | Extra rows mounted before and after the visible window. |

### Events

| Name | Detail | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| rowan-cell-action |  | Fired when a link or button cell activates. Cancelable; preventDefault on a link action to block navigation. |
| rowan-cell-bind |  | Fired once for each cloned custom slot cell |
| rowan-cell-change |  | Fired when checkbox cell value changes |
| rowan-column-filter |  | Fired from a column menu filter field. Cancelable. `detail` is `{ columnId, value }`. `preventDefault()` leaves `filters` unchanged. |
| rowan-column-reorder |  | Fired when columns are reordered. `detail` contains fromIndex, toIndex, and columns array. |
| rowan-column-resize |  | Fired when a column is resized. `detail` contains columnId, width, and columns array. |
| rowan-copy |  | Fired before a clipboard write. Cancelable. `detail.text` is TSV and `detail.html` is an HTML table. Listeners may replace either, or `detail.rows`. |
| rowan-data-error |  | Fired when `getRows` rejects. `detail.error` is the Error. The error row offers retry. |
| rowan-data-load |  | Fired after `getRows` resolves. `detail` includes `rows`, `total`, and the query. |
| rowan-data-request |  | Fired before a server read. Cancelable. `detail` is `{ page, pageSize, sort, filters }`. `preventDefault()` skips the request. |
| rowan-edit-cancel |  | Fired when a cell edit is discarded. |
| rowan-edit-commit |  | Fired when a cell value is accepted. Cancelable. |
| rowan-edit-start |  | Fired before a cell editor opens. Cancelable. |
| rowan-edit-validate |  | Fired before a cell or row commit, after `required` and `validate`. Cancelable. `preventDefault()` keeps the editor open. Not part of the commit event, so a rejected value is never delivered to commit listeners. `detail.message` is the error text; listeners may replace it. |
| rowan-export |  | Fired before a CSV or Excel download. Cancelable. `detail` includes `format`, `filename`, `header`, `rows`, and `truncated`. Listeners may replace `filename` or `rows`. |
| rowan-group-toggle |  | Fired when a group header is expanded or collapsed by the user |
| rowan-page-change |  | Fired when pagination changes. `detail.index` is 0-based; `detail.page` is 1-based. |
| rowan-paste |  | Fired before pasted cells are validated. Cancelable. `detail` includes the start cell, the TSV matrix, and `targets`. Listeners may change `targets` or call `preventDefault()`. |
| rowan-paste-result |  | Fired after a paste. `detail.applied` and `detail.rejected` list the cells, with `message` on rejects. `detail.ignored` counts values that did not fit. |
| rowan-row-activate |  | Fired on row activation by keyboard or double click. Not fired from interactive cells, and not fired when `rowActivate` is `none`. |
| rowan-row-edit-cancel |  | Fired when a row edit is discarded. |
| rowan-row-edit-commit |  | Fired when every editable cell in a row is valid. Cancelable. `detail.values` and `detail.oldValues` are keyed by column id. |
| rowan-select |  | Fired when row selection changes |
| rowan-sort |  | Fired when a sortable header changes direction. `detail` is the changed `{ id, dir }`. |
| rowan-sort-change |  | Fired when the user changes the sort. `detail.sort` is the full ordered array of `{ id, dir }`. |
| rowan-tree-toggle |  | Fired when a tree row expands or collapses. `detail` is `{ rowId, expanded, row }`. |

### Slots

| Name | Description |
| --- | --- |
| caption |  |
| empty |  |
| footer |  |
| toolbar | View controls. Shares the table's outer chrome; nested cards drop their own border. |

### CSS parts

| Name | Description |
| --- | --- |
| caption |  |
| spacer |  |
| table |  |
| tbody |  |
| td |  |
| th |  |
| thead |  |
| toolbar |  |
| tr |  |
| viewport |  |

### CSS properties

| Name | Description |
| --- | --- |
| --rowan-table-virtual-height |  |

### Methods

| Name | Description |
| --- | --- |
| clearSelection() |  |
| collapseAll() | Collapses every tree row. |
| copyToClipboard(options) | Copy selected rows, or the focused cell when nothing is selected, as TSV and an HTML table. |
| expandAll() | Opens every loaded tree parent. Child fetches run when a row has no local children. |
| exportCsv(options) | Download a CSV file. In server mode the loaded page is exported unless `getRows` supplies the full set. |
| exportExcel(options) | Download a real .xlsx workbook. Options match `exportCsv`. |
| pasteText(text, options) | Paste TSV at the focused editable cell. Omit `text` to read the clipboard. |
| selectAll() |  |
| sortBy(id, dir, options) |  |

### Examples

### HTML

```html
<!doctype html>
<html lang="en">
  <head>
    <meta charset="utf-8" />
    <title>Table</title>
    <script type="module">
      import "@rowan-ui/core/tokens";
      import "@rowan-ui/core/tokens/light";
      import "@rowan-ui/core/table";
    </script>
  </head>
  <body>
    <rowan-table id="members-table" caption="Active members" caption-visually-hidden>
  <rowan-table-toolbar slot="toolbar" label="Member table controls" column-picker>
    <span slot="start">Active members</span>
  </rowan-table-toolbar>
</rowan-table>

<script type="module">
  const table = document.querySelector("#members-table");
  table.config = {
    selectable: "multiple",
    rowId: "id",
    columns: [{ id: "name", header: "Name" }],
    rows: [{ id: "1", name: "Ada" }],
  };
</script>
  </body>
</html>
```

### React

```tsx
import "@rowan-ui/core/tokens";
import "@rowan-ui/core/tokens/light";
import { RowanTable } from "@rowan-ui/core/react/table";

// RowanTable maps onRowanCellAction to the rowan-cell-action event.
export function Example() {
  return (
    <RowanTable id="members-table" caption="Active members" caption-visually-hidden>
      <RowanTable-toolbar slot="toolbar" label="Member table controls" column-picker>
        <span slot="start">Active members</span>
      </rowan-table-toolbar>
    </RowanTable>
    
    <script type="module">
      const table = document.querySelector("#members-table");
      table.config = {
        selectable: "multiple",
        rowId: "id",
        columns: [{ id: "name", header: "Name" }],
        rows: [{ id: "1", name: "Ada" }],
      };
    </script>
  );
}
```

```html
          columns: [

            { id: "email", header: "Email", type: "text" },

          ],
        };

          console.log("Column reordered:", event.detail);
        });
      </script>
```

## rowan-table-toolbar

Table operations surface for filters and density. Selection count hides when a bulk-actions-bar is on the same table. A nested `panel` filter-builder wraps to a full second row; `appearance="toolbar"` chips stay on the first row. `column-picker` is a `rowan-dropdown` that follows the linked table's `columns` whenever they are assigned or replaced, before or after this element upgrades or connects, and when a column menu hides or shows a column.

- Package: `@rowan-ui/core@0.23.4`
- Import: `@rowan-ui/core/table-toolbar`
- React: `RowanTableToolbar` from `@rowan-ui/core/react/table-toolbar`
- Docs: https://2351labs.github.io/rowan/#table-toolbar
- Module: `src/table-toolbar/table-toolbar.js`

### Attributes

| Name | Type | Default | Reflects | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| column-picker | boolean | false | yes | Column visibility menu. Stays hidden until the linked table has columns, then tracks later replacements. |
| for-table | string |  | yes |  |
| label | string | Table controls | yes |  |
| selection-label | string | selected | yes |  |

### Properties

| Name | Type | Default | Reflects | Readonly | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| columnPicker |  | false | yes |  |  |
| externalLabelText |  |  |  | yes | Text of any `<label for>` bound to the host. `label`/`for` cannot cross a shadow boundary. |
| forTable |  |  | yes |  |  |
| label |  | Table controls | yes |  |  |
| messages | RowanTableToolbarMessages |  |  |  | Property-only built-in message overrides. |
| selected |  |  |  | yes |  |
| selectedCount |  |  |  | yes |  |
| selectedRows |  |  |  | yes |  |
| selectionLabel |  | selected | yes |  |  |
| table |  |  |  |  |  |

### Events

None.

### Slots

| Name | Description |
| --- | --- |
| (default) | Primary table controls |
| end | Trailing table controls |
| selection | Additional content beside the selected-row status |
| start | Leading filters or navigation controls |

### CSS parts

| Name | Description |
| --- | --- |
| column-picker |  |
| column-picker-menu |  |
| content |  |
| end |  |
| selection |  |
| selection-text |  |
| start |  |
| toolbar |  |

### CSS properties

| Name | Description |
| --- | --- |
| --rowan-table-toolbar-bg |  |
| --rowan-table-toolbar-border |  |

| Name | Description |
| --- | --- |
| refresh() |  |

- Module: `src/tree/tree.js`

### Attributes

| Name | Type | Default | Reflects | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| label | string |  | yes |  |
| selection | "none"\|"single"\|"multiple" | single | yes |  |

### Properties

| Name | Type | Default | Reflects | Readonly | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| externalLabelText |  |  |  | yes | Text of any `<label for>` bound to the host. `label`/`for` cannot cross a shadow boundary. |
| label |  |  | yes |  |  |
| selected | string[] |  |  |  | Selected item values. Arrays are property-only. |
| selectedItems | HTMLElement[] |  |  | yes |  |
| selection | RowanTreeSelection | single | yes |  |  |

### Events

| Name | Detail | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| rowan-change |  | Fired when a user changes the selection |
| rowan-toggle |  | Fired when a user expands or collapses an item |

### Slots

| Name | Description |
| --- | --- |
| (default) | Direct rowan-tree-item nodes |

### CSS parts

| Name | Description |
| --- | --- |
| tree |  |

### CSS properties

| Name | Description |
| --- | --- |
| --rowan-tree-fg |  |

### Methods

| Name | Description |
| --- | --- |
| clearSelection() |  |

### Examples

### HTML

```html
<!doctype html>
<html lang="en">
  <head>
    <meta charset="utf-8" />
    <title>Tree</title>
    <script type="module">
      import "@rowan-ui/core/tokens";
      import "@rowan-ui/core/tokens/light";
      import "@rowan-ui/core/tree";
    </script>
  </head>
  <body>
    <rowan-tree id="docs-tree" label="Documentation">
  <rowan-tree-item value="guides" expanded>
    Guides
    <rowan-tree-item slot="children" value="getting-started">
      Getting started
    </rowan-tree-item>
  </rowan-tree-item>
  <rowan-tree-item value="reference">Reference</rowan-tree-item>
</rowan-tree>

<script type="module">
  import "@rowan-ui/core/tree";

  const tree = document.querySelector("#docs-tree");
  tree.selected = ["getting-started"];

  tree.addEventListener("rowan-change", (event) => {
    console.log(event.detail.selected);
  });
</script>
  </body>
</html>
```

### React

```tsx
import "@rowan-ui/core/tokens";
import "@rowan-ui/core/tokens/light";
import { RowanTree } from "@rowan-ui/core/react/tree";

// RowanTree maps onRowanChange to the rowan-change event.
export function Example() {
  return (
    <RowanTree id="docs-tree" label="Documentation">
      <RowanTree-item value="guides" expanded>
        Guides
        <RowanTree-item slot="children" value="getting-started">
          Getting started
        </rowan-tree-item>
      </rowan-tree-item>
      <RowanTree-item value="reference">Reference</rowan-tree-item>
    </RowanTree>
    
    <script type="module">
      import "@rowan-ui/core/tree";
    
      const tree = document.querySelector("#docs-tree");
      tree.selected = ["getting-started"];
    
      tree.addEventListener("rowan-change", (event) => {
        console.log(event.detail.selected);
      });
    </script>
  );
}
```

### Excerpt from documentation/app.js (TREE_SNIPPET)

```html

    Guides
```

## rowan-trend-chart

Frozen small multi-series line chart for operational data sets. Native SVG, no animation, and an equivalent semantic table. Other geometries are separate hosts.

- Package: `@rowan-ui/core@0.23.4`
- Import: `@rowan-ui/core/trend-chart`
- React: `RowanTrendChart` from `@rowan-ui/core/react/trend-chart`
- Docs: https://2351labs.github.io/rowan/#trend-chart
- Module: `src/trend-chart/trend-chart.js`

### Attributes

| Name | Type | Default | Reflects | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| brush | boolean | false | yes | Drag, or Shift+Arrow, to select an x range. Escape clears it. |
| description | string |  | yes |  |
| hidden-series | string |  | yes | Space-separated series or slice ids hidden from the plot. |
| interactive | boolean | false | yes |  |
| label | string |  | yes |  |
| large-series | number |  |  | Downsample drawn marks above this count. The data table keeps every row. |
| locale | string |  | yes |  |
| no-motion | boolean | false | yes | Disables chart motion, including under prefers-reduced-motion. |
| sync-group | string |  |  | Share the axis pointer with charts that use the same group name. |
| zoom | boolean | false | yes | Opt-in plot zoom and pan. |

### Properties

| Name | Type | Default | Reflects | Readonly | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| config | RowanTrendChartConfig |  |  |  | Replaces the complete chart configuration. |
| description |  |  | yes |  |  |
| externalLabelText |  |  |  | yes | Text of any `<label for>` bound to the host. `label`/`for` cannot cross a shadow boundary. |
| hiddenSeries | string[] |  | yes |  | Ids hidden from the plot. The data table still lists them. |
| interactive |  | false | yes |  |  |
| label |  |  | yes |  |  |
| labels | string[] |  |  | yes | Point labels shared across series. Arrays are property-only. |
| locale |  |  | yes |  |  |
| messages | RowanTrendChartMessages |  |  |  | Property-only built-in message overrides. |
| noMotion |  |  | yes |  |  |
| series | Array<RowanTrendChartSeries> |  |  |  | Chart series. Arrays are property-only. |
| tooltipFormatter | ((context: { text: string, event: Event, host: HTMLElement }) => string) \| null |  |  |  | Custom tooltip text. Property-only. |
| valueFormatter | RowanTrendChartValueFormatter \| null |  |  |  | Formats chart and table values. Its context includes tick for compact axis labels. Functions are property-only. |

### Events

| Name | Detail | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| rowan-brush | startIndex, endIndex, startLabel, endLabel, or cleared. | Selected range. Detail: startIndex, endIndex, startLabel, endLabel, or cleared. |
| rowan-point-activate |  | Fired when a user activates an interactive data point. |
| rowan-point-click | series, index, datum, value. | Cancelable. Detail: series, index, datum, value. |
| rowan-selection-change |  | Cancelable. Follows rowan-point-click when that event is not canceled. |
| rowan-series-toggle | seriesId, hiddenSeries. | Cancelable. Legend visibility toggle. Detail: seriesId, hiddenSeries. |
| rowan-sync | group, index, label. | Shared hover. Detail: group, index, label. |
| rowan-zoom | x, y, width, height. | Fired when the zoom window changes. Detail: x, y, width, height. |

### Slots

| Name | Description |
| --- | --- |
| description | Replaces the description attribute. |
| label | Replaces the label attribute. |
| tooltip | Custom tooltip content, used when tooltipFormatter is unset. |

### CSS parts

| Name | Description |
| --- | --- |
| chart |  |
| control |  |
| description |  |
| detail |  |
| label |  |
| legend |  |
| legend-item |  |
| legend-swatch |  |
| plot |  |
| point |  |
| summary |  |
| table |  |

### CSS properties

| Name | Description |
| --- | --- |
| --rowan-trend-chart-bg |  |
| --rowan-trend-chart-series-1 |  |
| --rowan-trend-chart-series-2 |  |

### Methods

None.

### Examples

### HTML

```html
<!doctype html>
<html lang="en">
  <head>
    <meta charset="utf-8" />
    <title>Trend Chart</title>
    <script type="module">
      import "@rowan-ui/core/tokens";
      import "@rowan-ui/core/tokens/light";
      import "@rowan-ui/core/trend-chart";
    </script>
  </head>
  <body>
    <rowan-trend-chart
  id="on-call-workload"
  label="On-call workload"
  description="Incoming and resolved incidents by day."
  interactive
></rowan-trend-chart>

<script type="module">
  import "@rowan-ui/core/trend-chart";

  const chart = document.querySelector("#on-call-workload");
  chart.config = {
    labels: ["Mon", "Tue", "Wed", "Thu", "Fri", "Sat"],
    interactive: true,
    series: [
      { id: "incoming", label: "Incoming incidents", values: [18, 24, null, 12, 15, 9] },
      { id: "resolved", label: "Resolved incidents", values: [13, 19, 20, 15, 16, 12] },
    ],
    valueFormatter: (value, context) =>
      context.tick ? String(value) : \
  </body>
</html>
```

### React

```tsx
import "@rowan-ui/core/tokens";
import "@rowan-ui/core/tokens/light";
import { RowanTrendChart } from "@rowan-ui/core/react/trend-chart";

// RowanTrendChart maps onRowanBrush to the rowan-brush event.
export function Example() {
  return (
    <RowanTrendChart
      id="on-call-workload"
      label="On-call workload"
      description="Incoming and resolved incidents by day."
      interactive
     />
    
    <script type="module">
      import "@rowan-ui/core/trend-chart";
    
      const chart = document.querySelector("#on-call-workload");
      chart.config = {
        labels: ["Mon", "Tue", "Wed", "Thu", "Fri", "Sat"],
        interactive: true,
        series: [
          { id: "incoming", label: "Incoming incidents", values: [18, 24, null, 12, 15, 9] },
          { id: "resolved", label: "Resolved incidents", values: [13, 19, 20, 15, 16, 12] },
        ],
        valueFormatter: (value, context) =>
          context.tick ? String(value) : \
  );
}
```

### Excerpt from documentation/app.js (TREND_CHART_SNIPPET)

```html
<rowan-trend-chart
  id="on-call-workload"
  label="On-call workload"
  description="Incoming and resolved incidents by day."
  interactive
></rowan-trend-chart>

<script type="module">
  import "@rowan-ui/core/trend-chart";

  const chart = document.querySelector("#on-call-workload");
  chart.config = {
    labels: ["Mon", "Tue", "Wed", "Thu", "Fri", "Sat"],
    interactive: true,
    series: [
      { id: "incoming", label: "Incoming incidents", values: [18, 24, null, 12, 15, 9] },
      { id: "resolved", label: "Resolved incidents", values: [13, 19, 20, 15, 16, 12] },
    ],
    valueFormatter: (value, context) =>
      context.tick ? String(value) : `${value} incidents`,
  };
</script>
```


## rowan-validation-summary

Renders a navigable summary of validation errors.

- Package: `@rowan-ui/core@0.23.4`
- Import: `@rowan-ui/core/validation-summary`
- React: `RowanValidationSummary` from `@rowan-ui/core/react/validation-summary`
- Docs: https://2351labs.github.io/rowan/#validation-summary
- Module: `src/validation-summary/validation-summary.js`

### Attributes

| Name | Type | Default | Reflects | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| disabled | boolean | false | yes |  |
| for-form | string |  | yes |  |
| heading | string |  | yes |  |
| show-empty | boolean | false | yes | Show the empty message when there are no errors. Default is hidden. |

### Properties

| Name | Type | Default | Reflects | Readonly | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| disabled |  | false | yes |  |  |
| errors |  |  |  |  |  |
| externalLabelText |  |  |  | yes | Text of any `<label for>` bound to the host. `label`/`for` cannot cross a shadow boundary. |
| forForm |  |  | yes |  |  |
| heading |  |  | yes |  |  |
| messages | RowanValidationSummaryMessages |  |  |  | Property-only built-in message overrides. |
| showEmpty |  | false | yes |  |  |

### Events

| --- | --- | --- |

| --- | --- |

### Examples

### HTML

```html
<!doctype html>
<html lang="en">
  <head>
    <meta charset="utf-8" />
    <title>Validation Summary</title>
    <script type="module">
      import "@rowan-ui/core/tokens";
      import "@rowan-ui/core/tokens/light";
      import "@rowan-ui/core/validation-summary";
    </script>
  </head>
  <body>
    <form id="profile-form">
  <label for="profile-name">Name</label>
  <input id="profile-name" name="name" required />

  <label for="profile-email">Email</label>
  <input id="profile-email" name="email" type="email" required />
</form>

<rowan-validation-summary
  for-form="profile-form"
  heading="Please fix these fields"
></rowan-validation-summary>
  </body>
</html>
```

### React

```tsx
import "@rowan-ui/core/tokens";
import "@rowan-ui/core/tokens/light";
import { RowanValidationSummary } from "@rowan-ui/core/react/validation-summary";

// RowanValidationSummary maps onRowanJump to the rowan-jump event.
export function Example() {
  return (
    <form id="profile-form">
      <label for="profile-name">Name</label>
      <input id="profile-name" name="name" required />
    
      <label for="profile-email">Email</label>
      <input id="profile-email" name="email" type="email" required />
    </form>
    
    <RowanValidationSummary
      for-form="profile-form"
      heading="Please fix these fields"
     />
  );
}
```

## rowan-virtual-list

Virtualized, keyed collection for large property-driven item sets.

- Package: `@rowan-ui/core@0.23.4`
- Import: `@rowan-ui/core/virtual-list`
- React: `RowanVirtualList` from `@rowan-ui/core/react/virtual-list`
- Docs: https://2351labs.github.io/rowan/#virtual-list
- Module: `src/virtual-list/virtual-list.js`

### Attributes

| Name | Type | Default | Reflects | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| item-size | number |  | yes |  |
| overscan | number |  | yes |  |

### Properties

| Name | Type | Default | Reflects | Readonly | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| externalLabelText |  |  |  | yes | Text of any `<label for>` bound to the host. `label`/`for` cannot cross a shadow boundary. |
| itemKey | string \| ((item: unknown, index: number) => string \| number) |  |  |  | Stable item key accessor. |
| items | Array<unknown> |  |  |  | Property-only item data. |
| itemSize | number |  | yes |  |  |
| overscan | number |  | yes |  |  |
| renderItem | ((item: unknown, index: number, itemEl: HTMLElement) => Node \| string \| void) \| null |  |  |  | Renders a visible item. |

### Events

None.

### Slots

None.

### CSS parts

| Name | Description |
| --- | --- |
| content |  |
| item |  |
| items |  |
| viewport |  |

### CSS properties

| Name | Description |
| --- | --- |
| --rowan-virtual-list-bg |  |
| --rowan-virtual-list-border-color |  |
| --rowan-virtual-list-fg |  |
| --rowan-virtual-list-height |  |
| --rowan-virtual-list-radius |  |

### Methods

| Name | Description |
| --- | --- |
| scrollToIndex(index, options) | Scrolls an item into the list's rendered window. |

### Examples

### HTML

```html
<!doctype html>
<html lang="en">
  <head>
    <meta charset="utf-8" />
    <title>Virtual List</title>
    <script type="module">
      import "@rowan-ui/core/tokens";
      import "@rowan-ui/core/tokens/light";
      import "@rowan-ui/core/virtual-list";
    </script>
  </head>
  <body>
    <rowan-virtual-list id="member-list" item-size="44" overscan="4"></rowan-virtual-list>

<script type="module">
  import "@rowan-ui/core/virtual-list";

  const list = document.querySelector("#member-list");
  list.items = Array.from({ length: 500 }, (_value, index) => ({
    id: "member-" + (index + 1),
    name: "Member " + (index + 1),
  }));
  list.itemKey = "id";
  list.renderItem = (item) => {
    const row = document.createElement("div");
    row.textContent = item.name;
    return row;
  };
</script>
  </body>
</html>
```

### React

```tsx
import "@rowan-ui/core/tokens";
import "@rowan-ui/core/tokens/light";
import { RowanVirtualList } from "@rowan-ui/core/react/virtual-list";

export function Example() {
  return (
    <RowanVirtualList id="member-list" item-size="44" overscan="4" />
    
    <script type="module">
      import "@rowan-ui/core/virtual-list";
    
      const list = document.querySelector("#member-list");
      list.items = Array.from({ length: 500 }, (_value, index) => ({
        id: "member-" + (index + 1),
        name: "Member " + (index + 1),
      }));
      list.itemKey = "id";
      list.renderItem = (item) => {
        const row = document.createElement("div");
        row.textContent = item.name;
        return row;
      };
    </script>
  );
}
```

### Excerpt from documentation/app.js (VIRTUAL_LIST_SNIPPET)

```html
<rowan-virtual-list id="member-list" item-size="44" overscan="4"></rowan-virtual-list>

<script type="module">
  import "@rowan-ui/core/virtual-list";

  const list = document.querySelector("#member-list");
  list.items = Array.from({ length: 500 }, (_value, index) => ({
    id: "member-" + (index + 1),
    name: "Member " + (index + 1),
  }));
  list.itemKey = "id";
  list.renderItem = (item) => {
    const row = document.createElement("div");
    row.textContent = item.name;
    return row;
  };
</script>
```


## rowan-waterfall-chart

Waterfall. Signed deltas from a running total. Totals are `{ type: "total" }` from zero; the host does not invent them. Null is no-data.

- Package: `@rowan-ui/core@0.23.4`
- Import: `@rowan-ui/core/waterfall-chart`
- React: `RowanWaterfallChart` from `@rowan-ui/core/react/waterfall-chart`
- Docs: https://2351labs.github.io/rowan/#waterfall-chart
- Module: `src/waterfall-chart/waterfall-chart.js`

### Attributes

| Name | Type | Default | Reflects | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| brush | boolean | false | yes | Drag, or Shift+Arrow, to select an x range. Escape clears it. |
| description | string |  | yes |  |
| hidden-series | string |  | yes | Space-separated series or slice ids hidden from the plot. |
| interactive | boolean | false | yes |  |
| label | string |  | yes |  |
| large-series | number |  |  | Downsample drawn marks above this count. The data table keeps every row. |
| locale | string |  | yes |  |
| no-motion | boolean | false | yes | Disables chart motion, including under prefers-reduced-motion. |
| sync-group | string |  |  | Share the axis pointer with charts that use the same group name. |
| zoom | boolean | false | yes | Opt-in plot zoom and pan. |

### Properties

| Name | Type | Default | Reflects | Readonly | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| config | object |  |  |  | Replaces the complete chart configuration. |
| description |  |  | yes |  |  |
| externalLabelText |  |  |  | yes | Text of any `<label for>` bound to the host. `label`/`for` cannot cross a shadow boundary. |
| hiddenSeries | string[] |  | yes |  | Ids hidden from the plot. The data table still lists them. |
| interactive |  | false | yes |  |  |
| label |  |  | yes |  |  |
| labels | string[] |  |  | yes | Category labels. Arrays are property-only. |
| locale |  |  | yes |  |  |
| messages | RowanWaterfallChartMessages |  |  |  | Property-only built-in message overrides. |
| noMotion |  |  | yes |  |  |
| series | Array<object> |  |  |  | First series of `{ value, type?: "total" }`. Arrays are property-only. |
| tooltipFormatter | ((context: { text: string, event: Event, host: HTMLElement }) => string) \| null |  |  |  | Custom tooltip text. Property-only. |
| valueFormatter | RowanChartValueFormatter \| null |  |  |  | Formats table and hover values. Functions are property-only. |

### Events

| Name | Detail | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| rowan-brush | startIndex, endIndex, startLabel, endLabel, or cleared. | Selected range. Detail: startIndex, endIndex, startLabel, endLabel, or cleared. |
| rowan-point-activate |  | Fired when a user activates an interactive bar. |
| rowan-point-click | series, index, datum, value. | Cancelable. Detail: series, index, datum, value. |
| rowan-selection-change |  | Cancelable. Follows rowan-point-click when that event is not canceled. |
| rowan-series-toggle | seriesId, hiddenSeries. | Cancelable. Legend visibility toggle. Detail: seriesId, hiddenSeries. |
| rowan-sync | group, index, label. | Shared hover. Detail: group, index, label. |
| rowan-zoom | x, y, width, height. | Fired when the zoom window changes. Detail: x, y, width, height. |

### Slots

| Name | Description |
| --- | --- |
| description |  |
| label |  |
| tooltip | Custom tooltip content, used when tooltipFormatter is unset. |

### CSS parts

| Name | Description |
| --- | --- |
| bar |  |
| control |  |
| hover |  |
| plot |  |
| table |  |

### CSS properties

| Name | Description |
| --- | --- |
| --rowan-waterfall-chart-bg |  |

### Methods

None.

### Examples

### HTML

```html
  <head>
    <meta charset="utf-8" />
    <title>Waterfall Chart</title>
    <script type="module">
      import "@rowan-ui/core/tokens";
      import "@rowan-ui/core/tokens/light";
      import "@rowan-ui/core/waterfall-chart";
    </script>
  </head>
```
